skills.name: Healing Signet
skills.title: Healing Signet
skills.desc: Signet. You gain 82..172 Health. You have -40 armor while using this skill.
notes: ANOMALY: The armor penalty from this skill is applied after the armor cap and the effects of Cracked Armor and armor penetration.
BUG: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.

skills.name: Resurrection Signet
skills.title: Resurrection Signet
skills.desc: Signet. Resurrect target party member. That party member is returned to life with 100% Health and 25% Energy. This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.
notes: ANOMALY: This skill, along with all other skills, recharges when zoning, despite the description text stating it requires a morale boost.
ANOMALY: When used on an invalid target, this skill incorrectly gives the "Invalid spell target." message rather than the generic "Invalid target." message.

skills.name: Power Block
skills.title: Power Block
skills.desc: Elite Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill and all skills of the same attribute are disabled for 1..12 seconds and that skill is interrupted.

skills.name: Mantra of Earth
skills.title: Mantra of Earth
skills.desc: Stance. For 30..90 seconds, whenever you take earth damage, the damage is reduced by 26..50% and you gain 2 Energy.

skills.name: Mantra of Flame
skills.title: Mantra of Flame
skills.desc: Stance. For 30..90 seconds, whenever you take fire damage, the damage is reduced by 26..50% and you gain 2 Energy.

skills.name: Mantra of Frost
skills.title: Mantra of Frost
skills.desc: Stance. For 30..90 seconds, whenever you take cold damage, the damage is reduced by 26..50% and you gain 2 Energy.

skills.name: Mantra of Lightning
skills.title: Mantra of Lightning
skills.desc: Stance. For 30..90 seconds, whenever you take lightning damage, the damage is reduced by 26..50% and you gain 2 Energy.

skills.name: Hex Breaker
skills.title: Hex Breaker
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..80 seconds, the next time you are the target of a hex, that hex fails and the caster takes 10..46 damage.

skills.name: Distortion
skills.title: Distortion
skills.desc: Stance. For 1..5 second[s], you have a 75% chance to block attacks. Whenever you block an attack this way, you lose 2 Energy or Distortion ends.

skills.name: Mantra of Recovery
skills.title: Mantra of Recovery
skills.desc: Elite Stance. For 5..20 seconds, spells you cast recharge 33% faster.

skills.name: Mantra of Persistence
skills.title: Mantra of Persistence
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..25 seconds, any Illusion Magic hex you cast lasts 10..40% longer.

skills.name: Mantra of Inscriptions
skills.title: Mantra of Inscriptions
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..25 seconds, signets you successfully activate while in this stance recharge 10..40% faster.

skills.name: Mantra of Concentration
skills.title: Mantra of Concentration
skills.desc: Stance. For 1..38 seconds, the next time you would be interrupted, you are not interrupted.

skills.name: Inspired Enchantment
skills.title: Inspired Enchantment
skills.desc: Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe and gain 3..15 Energy. For 20 seconds, Inspired Enchantment is replaced with the enchantment removed from target foe.

skills.name: Inspired Hex
skills.title: Inspired Hex
skills.desc: Spell. Remove a hex from target ally and gain 4..10 Energy. For 20 seconds, Inspired Hex is replaced with the hex that was removed.

skills.name: Power Spike
skills.title: Power Spike
skills.desc: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or a chant, that skill is interrupted and target foe takes 30..120 damage.

skills.name: Power Leak
skills.title: Power Leak
skills.desc: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and target foe loses 3..17 Energy.

skills.name: Power Drain
skills.title: Power Drain
skills.desc: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and you gain 1..31 Energy.

skills.name: Backfire
skills.title: Backfire
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, that foe takes 35..140 damage.

skills.name: Blackout
skills.title: Blackout
skills.desc: Skill. For 2..8 seconds, all of touched target foe's skills are disabled, and all of your skills are disabled for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Diversion
skills.title: Diversion
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next time target foe uses a skill, that skill takes an additional 10..56 seconds to recharge.

skills.name: Conjure Phantasm
skills.title: Conjure Phantasm
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 4..18 seconds, target foe experiences -5 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Illusion of Weakness
skills.title: Illusion of Weakness
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. You lose 50..240 Health. Illusion of Weakness ends if damage drops your Health below 25% of your maximum. When Illusion of Weakness ends, you gain 50..240 Health.
notes: BUG: Despite the skill descriptions, this skill heals rather than provide health gain.

skills.name: Sympathetic Visage
skills.title: Sympathetic Visage
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 4..10 seconds, whenever target ally is hit by a melee attack, all adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy.

skills.name: Ignorance
skills.title: Ignorance
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 8..20 seconds target foe cannot use signets.

skills.name: Arcane Conundrum
skills.title: Arcane Conundrum
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5..15 seconds, spells cast by target foe and all adjacent foes take twice as long to cast. When this hex ends, you gain 1..7 energy.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike other hexes that affect the caster, this one doesn't end if the caster dies.

skills.name: Channeling
skills.title: Channeling
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 8..56 seconds, whenever you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for each foe in the area.

skills.name: Energy Surge
skills.title: Energy Surge
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1..10 Energy. For each point of Energy lost, that foe takes 7 damage and all nearby foes take 75% of that damage.

skills.name: Ether Feast
skills.title: Ether Feast
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe loses 3 Energy. You are healed 20..65 for each point of Energy lost.
notes: BUG: Contrary to the concise description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.

skills.name: Ether Lord
skills.title: Ether Lord
skills.desc: Hex Spell. You lose all Energy. For 5..10 seconds, target foe suffers -1..3 Energy degeneration, and you experience +1..3 Energy regeneration.

skills.name: Energy Burn

skills.desc: Spell. Target foe loses 1..10 Energy and takes 9 damage for each point of Energy lost.

skills.name: Clumsiness
skills.title: Clumsiness
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 4 seconds, target and adjacent foes are hexed with Clumsiness. The next time each foe attacks, the attack is interrupted and that foe suffers 10..80 damage.
notes: ANOMALY: Skills which prevent interruptions will trigger when hexed with Clumsiness but will not prevent their target from being interrupted nor from taking damage

skills.name: Phantom Pain
skills.title: Phantom Pain
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe suffers -1..4 Health degeneration. When Phantom Pain ends, that foe suffers a Deep Wound, lowering that foe's maximum Health by 20% for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Ethereal Burden
skills.title: Ethereal Burden
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 6..12 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When Ethereal Burden ends, you gain 10..18 Energy.

skills.name: Guilt
skills.title: Guilt
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next time target foe casts a spell that targets a foe, the spell fails and you steal up to 5..14 Energy from that foe.
notes: ANOMALY: Contrary to the concise description, Guilt will take effect if the hexed character attempts to cast a spell on any NPC hostile to them, including other foes. For example, in Varajar Fells, an Ice Imp's Maelstrom will fail if they attempt to cast it on a Modniir Hunter.

skills.name: Ineptitude
skills.title: Ineptitude
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 4 seconds, the next time target foe or any adjacent foe attacks, they take 30..135 damage and are Blinded for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Spirit of Failure
skills.title: Spirit of Failure
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe has a 25% chance to miss with attacks. You gain 1..3 Energy whenever that foe fails to hit in combat.

skills.name: Shame
skills.title: Shame
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next time target foe casts a spell that targets an ally, the spell fails and you steal up to 5..14 Energy from that foe.

skills.name: Panic
skills.title: Panic
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 1..10 second[s], target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Panic. When a foe hexed with Panic successfully uses a skill, all other nearby foes are interrupted.
notes: ANOMALY: Also interrupts passive charmable animals when they are near a foe hexed with Panic.

skills.name: Soothing Images
skills.title: Soothing Images
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 8..20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes cannot gain adrenaline.

skills.name: Cry of Frustration
skills.title: Cry of Frustration
skills.desc: Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that foe and all foes in the area are interrupted and suffer 15..75 damage and foes in the area take 75% of that damage.

skills.name: Signet of Midnight
skills.title: Signet of Midnight
skills.desc: Elite Signet. You and target touched foe become Blinded for 15 seconds.

skills.name: Signet of Weariness
skills.title: Signet of Weariness
skills.desc: Signet. Target foe and all nearby foes lose 3..8 Energy and suffer from Weakness for 1..12 second[s].

skills.name: Leech Signet
skills.title: Leech Signet
skills.desc: Signet. Interrupt target foe's action. If that action was a spell, you gain 3..15 Energy.

skills.name: Signet of Humility
skills.title: Signet of Humility
skills.desc: Signet. Target foe's elite skill is disabled for 1..16 second[s]. Your non-Mesmer skills are disabled for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Keystone Signet
skills.title: Keystone Signet
skills.desc: Elite Signet. All of your signets except Keystone Signet are recharged. For 20 seconds, the next 0..6 time[s] you use a signet that targets a foe, all other foes adjacent to your target take 15..60 damage and are interrupted.
notes: BUG: Some non-English descriptions incorrectly expand the area of effect beyond adjacent foes: the French full description adds nearby foes and the German concise description adds the target.
BUG: At ranks 0-1 Fast Casting, all signets activated within the duration will deal damage and interrupt foes.

skills.name: Arcane Mimicry
skills.title: Arcane Mimicry
skills.desc: Spell. For 20 seconds, Arcane Mimicry becomes the non-form elite skill from target other ally.
notes: ANOMALY: No effect if target's elite skill is Junundu Siege.

skills.name: Spirit Shackles
skills.title: Spirit Shackles
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5..20 seconds, target foe loses 5 Energy whenever that foe attacks.

skills.name: Shatter Hex
skills.title: Shatter Hex
skills.desc: Spell. Remove a hex from target ally. If a hex is removed, foes near that ally take 30..120 damage.

skills.name: Drain Enchantment
skills.title: Drain Enchantment
skills.desc: Spell. Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, you gain 8..17 Energy and 40..120 Health.

skills.name: Shatter Enchantment
skills.title: Shatter Enchantment
skills.desc: Spell. Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, that foe takes 14..100 damage.

skills.name: Elemental Resistance
skills.title: Elemental Resistance
skills.desc: Stance. For 30..90 seconds, You gain +40 armor against elemental damage, but you lose 24..12 armor against physical damage.
notes: BUG: Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.

BUG: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that, after subtraction of the penalty from Elemental Resistance, still grants +26 or more armor rating against physical damage, Elemental Resistance's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.

skills.name: Physical Resistance
skills.title: Physical Resistance
skills.desc: Stance. For 30..90 seconds, You gain +40 armor against physical damage, but you lose 24..12 armor against elemental damage.
notes: BUG: Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.

BUG: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that, after subtraction of the penalty from Physical Resistance, still grants +26 or more armor rating against elemental damage, Physical Resistance's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.

skills.name: Echo
skills.title: Echo
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, Echo is replaced with the next skill you use. Echo acts as this skill for 30 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy a Signet of Capture and itself.

skills.name: Arcane Echo
skills.title: Arcane Echo
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. If you cast a spell in the next 20 seconds, Arcane Echo is replaced with that spell for 20 seconds. Arcane Echo ends prematurely if you use a non-spell skill.
notes: ANOMALY: Arcane Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy itself.

skills.name: Imagined Burden
skills.title: Imagined Burden
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 8..20 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower.

skills.desc: Spell. Create a Chaos Storm at target foe's location that lasts for 10 seconds. Each second, foes adjacent to this location take 5..25 damage and lose 0..2 Energy.

skills.desc: Spell. Spread all negative conditions and their remaining durations from target foe to all foes adjacent to your target.

skills.name: Energy Tap

skills.desc: Spell. Target foe loses 4..7 Energy. You gain 2 Energy for each point of Energy lost.

skills.name: Arcane Thievery
skills.title: Arcane Thievery
skills.desc: Spell. For 5..35 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe, and Arcane Thievery is replaced by that spell.

skills.name: Mantra of Recall
skills.title: Mantra of Recall
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you gain no benefit from it. You gain 10..25 Energy when Mantra of Recall ends.

skills.name: Animate Bone Horror
skills.title: Animate Bone Horror
skills.desc: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to animate a level 1..17 bone horror.

skills.name: Animate Bone Fiend
skills.title: Animate Bone Fiend
skills.desc: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to animate a level 1..17 bone fiend. Bone fiends can attack at range.

skills.name: Animate Bone Minions
skills.title: Animate Bone Minions
skills.desc: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to animate two level 0..12 bone minions.

skills.name: Grenth's Balance
skills.title: Grenth's Balance
skills.desc: Elite Spell. If target foe has more Health than you, you gain half the difference (up to your maximum Health), and that foe loses an equal amount. If this foe has less Health than you, you lose half the difference, and that foe gains an equal amount.
notes: ANOMALY: The concise description omits the fact that your health gain (and your target's health loss) is capped by your maximum health.

skills.name: Verata's Gaze
skills.title: Verata's Gaze
skills.desc: Spell. If target hostile animated undead has a master, its bond to its master is broken, making it hostile to all other creatures. If it had no master, you become its master and heal it for 60..80. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
notes: BUG: When casting Verata's Gaze on a masterless minion that was in a well, the effects of that well will persist even after the minion leaves, until the well expires.
BUG: When used on a Bone Horror immediately after it was created via Malign Intervention, the Bone Horror becomes stuck and will not move until you engage an enemy.

BUG: If this is cast on a minion, it will still follow its original owner, not the new owner. If the minion is turned hostile and then has this skill used on it as it is being summoned, it will follow the user of this skill, however if too slow it will follow its original owner again.
ANOMALY: This skill has no aftercast delay.

skills.name: Verata's Aura
skills.title: Verata's Aura
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. All hostile animated undead in the area become bound to you. Verata's Aura ends after 120..300 seconds. When Verata's Aura ends, you lose your bond with any undead bound to you. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
notes: ANOMALY: Recasting Verata's Aura starts a new timer; it does not reset the original one (as would be the case with other enchantments). The minions covered by the original Aura will become masterless as scheduled; any created between the two castings will be covered by the second enchantment. Consider bringing self enchantment removal skills such as Contemplation of Purity, and only renew the enchantment near its end.

skills.name: Deathly Chill
skills.title: Deathly Chill
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe is struck for 5..50 cold damage. If that foe's Health is above 50%, you deal an additional 5..50 shadow damage.

skills.name: Verata's Sacrifice
skills.title: Verata's Sacrifice
skills.desc: Spell. For 5..10 seconds, your undead allies gain +10 Health regeneration. All conditions are removed from those allies and transferred to you. If this spell is successful and you have control of 3 or fewer minions, Verata's Sacrifice instantly recharges.
notes: BUG: Heroes take minions of other party members into consideration.
BUG: The concise description fails to mention that only the caster's undead servants are affected.

skills.name: Well of Power
skills.title: Well of Power
skills.desc: Elite Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Power at that location. For 10..30 seconds, allies within the area of Well of Power gain +1..6 Health regeneration and +2 Energy regeneration.

skills.name: Well of Blood
skills.title: Well of Blood
skills.desc: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Blood at its location. For 8..20 seconds, allies in that area receive +1..6 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Well of Suffering
skills.title: Well of Suffering
skills.desc: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Suffering at its location. For 10..30 seconds, foes in that area suffer -1..6 Health degeneration.
notes: BUG: Only non-spirit foes experience the health degeneration.

skills.name: Well of the Profane
skills.title: Well of the Profane
skills.desc: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of the Profane at its location. For 8..20 seconds, foes in that area are stripped of all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
notes: ANOMALY: Foes in this well lose all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments; however, untargeted enchantments still work, which includes all flash enchantment spells, and spells like Shadow Refuge. These enchantments don’t get stripped simply by being inside the well, but only each time the well is entered. If one manages to gain an enchantment while inside (i.e. Aegis, Orders, etc.), it is not removed. [https://forum.guildwars.com/forum/forums/gamebugs/Well-of-the-Profane/ Source.]

skills.name: Putrid Explosion
skills.title: Putrid Explosion

skills.name: Soul Feast
skills.title: Soul Feast

skills.name: Consume Corpse
skills.title: Consume Corpse
skills.desc: Spell. Exploit a random corpse. You teleport to that corpse's location and gain 25..100 Health and 5..20 Energy.

skills.name: Parasitic Bond
skills.title: Parasitic Bond

skills.title: Soul Barbs

notes: BUG: Causes skills such as Xinrae's Weapon and Vengeful Weapon to trigger twice.

skills.name: Shadow Strike

skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe has a 25% chance to miss with attacks and takes 1..46 damage whenever that foe fails to hit in combat.

skills.name: Deathly Swarm
skills.title: Deathly Swarm
skills.desc: Spell. Deathly Swarm flies out slowly and strikes for 30..90 cold damage on up to three targets in the area.

skills.name: Rotting Flesh
skills.title: Rotting Flesh
skills.desc: Spell. Target fleshy foe becomes Diseased for 10..25 seconds, slowly losing Health.

skills.name: Virulence
skills.title: Virulence
skills.desc: Elite Spell. If target foe was already suffering from a condition, that foe suffers from Disease, Poison, and Weakness for 3..15 seconds.

skills.name: Suffering
skills.title: Suffering
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 6..30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -0..3 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Life Siphon
skills.title: Life Siphon
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 12..24 seconds, target foe suffers -1..3 Health degeneration, and you gain +1..3 Health regeneration.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to Augury of Death and enchantments with upkeep, if a hexed foe moves out of compass range of the caster, Life Siphon will end.

skills.name: Awaken the Blood
skills.title: Awaken the Blood
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 20..44 seconds, you gain +2 Blood Magic and +2 Curses, but whenever you sacrifice Health, you sacrifice 50% more than the normal amount.

skills.name: Desecrate Enchantments
skills.title: Desecrate Enchantments
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes take 6..60 shadow damage and 4..20 shadow damage for each enchantment on them.

skills.name: Tainted Flesh
skills.title: Tainted Flesh
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20..44 seconds, allies in the area are immune to disease, and anyone striking those allies in melee becomes Diseased for 3..15 seconds.
notes: BUG: Although this is a PBAoE skill with an effect centered around the caster, it still needs an allied target and you will run towards that target if not in cast range. Similar to Hex Eater Signet, the target won't be affected if it is not in range.

BUG: Because it is a targeted enchantment spell, it will always trigger Shame and Mark of Subversion. If standing in a Well of the Profane, you will be able to cast this enchantment if you pick any ally in cast range that is not inside the well.

skills.name: Aura of the Lich
skills.title: Aura of the Lich
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. All corpses within earshot are exploited and you animate a level 1..17 bone horror plus one for each corpse exploited in this way. For 5..45 seconds, your Death Magic attribute is increased by +1.

skills.name: Blood Renewal
skills.title: Blood Renewal
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 7 seconds, you gain +3..6 Health regeneration. When Blood Renewal ends, you gain 40..190 Health.
notes: BUG: Contrary to the full description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
BUG: Despite causing healing, this skill cannot trigger Scourge Healing.

skills.name: Dark Aura

skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, whenever target ally sacrifices Health, Dark Aura deals 5..50 shadow damage to adjacent foes, and you lose 5..20 Health.
notes: ANOMALY: Does not cause charmable animals to turn hostile.

skills.name: Blood is Power
skills.title: Blood is Power
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target other ally gains +3..6 Energy regeneration.
notes: BUG: Heroes will spam this skill on allies with heavy overcast, regardless of what percentage of energy the ally has.

skills.name: Blood of the Master

skills.desc: Spell. All of your undead allies are healed for 30..116 Health. You sacrifice an additional 2% maximum Health per minion healed in this way.
notes: BUG: The concise description is wrong regarding only healing your own minions.

skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 10..40 seconds, whenever target foe is struck for cold damage while using a skill, that foe is interrupted, and you lose 8..3 Energy or Spinal Shivers ends.

skills.name: Wither

skills.name: Life Transfer
skills.title: Life Transfer
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 6..12 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes suffer -3..8 Health degeneration, which you gain as Health regeneration.
notes: BUG: The concise description fails to mention that the regeneration is gained for each hexed foe.

skills.name: Mark of Subversion
skills.title: Mark of Subversion
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next time target foe casts a spell that targets an ally of that foe, the spell fails and you steal up to 10..92 Health from that foe.

skills.name: Soul Leech
skills.title: Soul Leech
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, you steal up to 16..80 Health from that foe.

skills.name: Defile Flesh
skills.title: Defile Flesh
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5..35 seconds, target foe gains only two-thirds Health from healing.

skills.name: Demonic Flesh
skills.title: Demonic Flesh
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 30..60 seconds, whenever you use a skill that targets a foe, you deal 5..20 shadow damage to all other foes adjacent to you.

skills.name: Barbed Signet
skills.title: Barbed Signet

skills.name: Plague Signet
skills.title: Plague Signet
skills.desc: Elite Signet. Transfer all negative conditions with 100..200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. (50% failure chance with Curses 4 or less.)

skills.name: Dark Pact
skills.title: Dark Pact
skills.desc: Spell. Deal 20..60 shadow damage to target foe.

skills.name: Order of Pain
skills.title: Order of Pain
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds, whenever a party member hits a foe with physical damage, that party member does +3..16 damage.

skills.name: Faintheartedness
skills.title: Faintheartedness
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For the next 4..18 seconds, target foe attacks 50% slower, and that foe suffers -1..3 Health degeneration.

skills.name: Shadow of Fear

skills.name: Rigor Mortis
skills.title: Rigor Mortis

skills.name: Dark Bond

notes: BUG: This skill does transfer Bleeding, Disease, and Poison to minions, despite them being non-fleshy.

skills.name: Malaise
skills.title: Malaise
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5..35 seconds, target foe suffers -1 Energy degeneration and you suffer -1 Health degeneration. If target foe's Energy reaches 0, that foe takes 5..50 damage and Malaise ends.

skills.name: Rend Enchantments

skills.desc: Spell. Remove 5..9 enchantments from target foe. For each Monk enchantment removed, you lose 55..25 Health.

skills.name: Lingering Curse
skills.title: Lingering Curse
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 6..30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -1..4 Health degeneration, and gain 25% less benefit from healing.

skills.name: Strip Enchantment
skills.title: Strip Enchantment
skills.desc: Spell. Remove 0..2 enchantment[s] from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, you steal 5..65 Health.

skills.name: Chilblains
skills.title: Chilblains
skills.desc: Spell. You become Poisoned for 10 seconds. Foes in the area of your target are struck for 10..44 cold damage and lose 1..2 enchantment[s].

skills.name: Offering of Blood
skills.title: Offering of Blood
skills.desc: Elite Spell. You gain 8..20 Energy.

skills.name: Dark Fury
skills.title: Dark Fury
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds, whenever any party member hits with an attack, that party member gains one hit of adrenaline. (50% failure chance with Blood Magic of 4 or less.)

skills.name: Order of the Vampire
skills.title: Order of the Vampire
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds, whenever a party member who is not under the effects of another Necromancer enchantment hits a foe with physical damage, that party member steals up to 3..16 Health.

skills.name: Plague Sending
skills.title: Plague Sending
skills.desc: Spell. Transfer 1..3 negative condition[s] and [its/their] remaining duration[s] from yourself to target foe and all adjacent foes.

skills.name: Mark of Pain
skills.title: Mark of Pain
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, whenever target foe takes physical damage, Mark of Pain deals 10..40 shadow damage to adjacent foes.

skills.name: Feast of Corruption
skills.title: Feast of Corruption
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 16..80 shadow damage. You steal up to 8..40 Health from each struck foe who is suffering from a hex.

skills.name: Taste of Death
skills.title: Taste of Death
skills.desc: Spell. Steal up to 100..400 Health from target animated undead ally.

skills.name: Vampiric Gaze
skills.title: Vampiric Gaze

skills.name: Plague Touch
skills.title: Plague Touch
skills.desc: Skill. Transfer 1..3 negative condition[s] and [its/their] remaining duration[s] from yourself to target touched foe.

skills.name: Vile Touch
skills.title: Vile Touch
skills.desc: Skill. Touch target foe to deal 20..65 damage.

skills.name: Vampiric Touch
skills.title: Vampiric Touch
skills.desc: Skill. Touch target foe to steal up to 29..74 Health.

skills.name: Blood Ritual
skills.title: Blood Ritual
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 8..14 seconds, target touched ally gains +3 Energy regeneration. Blood Ritual cannot be used on the caster.
notes: BUG: Heroes use this skill on overcast targets that cannot gain any energy.
BUG: The concise description omits that this is a touch-range skill.

skills.name: Touch of Agony
skills.title: Touch of Agony
skills.desc: Skill. Target touched foe takes 20..58 shadow damage.

skills.name: Weaken Armor
skills.title: Weaken Armor

skills.name: Windborne Speed

skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..13 seconds, target ally moves 33% faster.

skills.name: Gale
skills.title: Gale
skills.desc: Spell. Knock down target foe for 2 seconds. (50% failure chance with Air Magic 4 or less.)

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.title: Whirlwind
skills.desc: Spell. All adjacent foes take 15..75 cold damage. Attacking foes struck by Whirlwind are knocked down. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes nearby instead of adjacent.

skills.name: Elemental Attunement
skills.title: Elemental Attunement
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 25..60 seconds, you are attuned to Air, Fire, Water, and Earth and gain +1..2 to these attributes. You gain 1 Energy plus 50% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use magic associated with any of these elements.

skills.name: Armor of Earth
skills.title: Armor of Earth
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, you gain 24..60 armor, but move 50..14% slower.

skills.name: Kinetic Armor
skills.title: Kinetic Armor
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 12 seconds, you gain +20..80 armor. Whenever you cast a spell, Kinetic Armor is renewed for 12 seconds.

skills.name: Eruption
skills.title: Eruption
skills.desc: Spell. Cause an Eruption at target foe's location. Each second for 5 seconds, foes near this location are struck for 10..40 earth damage and are Blinded for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Magnetic Aura
skills.title: Magnetic Aura
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 1..8 second[s], you block the next attack against you and deal 10..50 damage to your attacker. If you are Overcast, all party members in earshot are also enchanted.

skills.name: Earth Attunement
skills.title: Earth Attunement
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 36..60 seconds, you are attuned to Earth. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Earth Magic.

skills.name: Earthquake
skills.title: Earthquake
skills.desc: Spell. You invoke an Earthquake at target foe's location. All foes near this location are knocked down and are struck for 26..100 earth damage.

skills.name: Stoning
skills.title: Stoning
skills.desc: Spell. Send out a large stone, striking target foe for 45..105 earth damage if it hits. If Stoning hits a foe suffering from Weakness, that foe is knocked down.

skills.name: Stone Daggers
skills.title: Stone Daggers
skills.desc: Spell. Send out two Stone Daggers. Each Stone Dagger strikes target foe for 8..33 earth damage if it hits. If you are Overcast, each projectile inflicts Bleeding for 1..5 second[s].

skills.name: Grasping Earth
skills.title: Grasping Earth
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5..20 seconds, all nearby foes move 50% slower.

skills.name: Aftershock
skills.title: Aftershock
skills.desc: Spell. Nearby foes are struck for 15..85 earth damage. Knocked down foes are struck for 15..85 additional earth damage.

skills.name: Ward Against Elements
skills.title: Ward Against Elements
skills.desc: Ward Spell. You create a Ward Against Elements at your current location. For 8..20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area gain +24 armor against elemental damage.

skills.name: Ward Against Melee
skills.title: Ward Against Melee
skills.desc: Ward Spell. You create a Ward Against Melee at your current location. For 5..20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have a 50% chance to block melee attacks.

skills.name: Ward Against Foes
skills.title: Ward Against Foes
skills.desc: Ward Spell. You create a Ward Against Foes at your current location. For 8..20 seconds, non-spirit foes in this area move 50% slower.

skills.name: Ether Prodigy
skills.title: Ether Prodigy
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. Lose all enchantments. For 8..20 seconds, you gain +6 Energy regeneration. When Ether Prodigy ends, you lose 2 Health for each point of Energy you have.

skills.name: Incendiary Bonds
skills.title: Incendiary Bonds
skills.desc: Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes are struck for 20..80 fire damage and are set on fire for 1..3 second[s]. Activates early if target foe dies.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to Lightning Strike and Lightning Surge, removing the hex before it ends will negate the end effect, unlike Shatterstone and most other skills with an end effect.

skills.name: Conjure Flame
skills.title: Conjure Flame
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a fire weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5..20 fire damage.

skills.name: Inferno
skills.title: Inferno
skills.desc: Spell. All adjacent foes are struck for 30..135 fire damage.

skills.name: Fire Attunement
skills.title: Fire Attunement
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 36..60 seconds, you are attuned to Fire. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Fire Magic.

skills.name: Mind Burn
skills.title: Mind Burn
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes take 15..60 fire damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe and all adjacent foes take an additional 15..60 fire damage and are set on fire for 1..10 second[s].
notes: ANOMALY: This skill checks the energy condition independently for each target hit.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.title: Fireball
skills.desc: Spell. Send out a ball of fire that strikes target foe and all nearby foes for 7..112 fire damage.

skills.name: Meteor
skills.title: Meteor
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 7..112 fire damage and knocked down.
notes: ANOMALY: There is a short delay between the skill activation and the actual effect of this spell that is not stated in the description. This spell actually hits target foe's location one second after being activated (and doesn't compensate for the movement of the target), so the effect can be avoided with speed boosts (including the speed buff given to hostile NPCs in Hard mode).

skills.name: Flame Burst
skills.title: Flame Burst
skills.desc: Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 15..120 fire damage.

skills.name: Rodgort's Invocation
skills.title: Rodgort's Invocation
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes are struck for 15..120 fire damage and set on fire for 1..3 second[s].

skills.name: Mark of Rodgort
skills.title: Mark of Rodgort
skills.desc: Hex Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Mark of Rodgort. For 10..35 seconds, whenever each foe is struck for fire damage, that foe is set on fire for 1..4 second[s].

skills.name: Immolate
skills.title: Immolate
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe is struck for 20..75 fire damage and is set on fire for 1..3 second[s].

skills.name: Meteor Shower
skills.title: Meteor Shower
skills.desc: Spell. Create a Meteor Shower at target foe's location. For 9 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 7..112 fire damage and knocked down every 3 seconds.

skills.name: Phoenix
skills.title: Phoenix
skills.desc: Spell. A fiery Phoenix rises at your location and flies out to your target, exploding on impact. This explosion strikes your target and nearby foes for 10..60 fire damage. If you are Overcast, allies in the blast radius are healed for 20..80 Health.

skills.name: Flare
skills.title: Flare
skills.desc: Spell. Send out a flare that strikes target foe for 20..65 fire damage if it hits. If you are Overcast, Flare hits adjacent foes as well.

skills.name: Lava Font
skills.title: Lava Font
skills.desc: Spell. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to the location where this spell was cast are struck for 5..50 fire damage each second. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes nearby foes instead of adjacent ones.
notes: BUG: Hero AI will use this spell without considering whether there are foes adjacent to them.

skills.name: Searing Heat
skills.title: Searing Heat
skills.desc: Spell. Cause Searing Heat at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes near this location are struck for 10..40 fire damage each second. When Searing Heat ends, foes in the area of effect are set on fire for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Fire Storm
skills.title: Fire Storm
skills.desc: Spell. Create a Fire Storm at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 5..35 fire damage each second.

skills.name: Glyph of Elemental Power
skills.title: Glyph of Elemental Power
skills.desc: Glyph. For 25 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 2 for your next 10 spells.
notes: ANOMALY: This skill actually behaves identically to Glyph of Energy, in that your elemental attributes are boosted for all purposes while under the effects of this glyph. * Non-spell skills (Lightning Touch, Shock, Glyph of Immolation and Glyph of Swiftness) will take advantage of the bonus and will not count as a use of the glyph. * Any elemental attribute raised to at least 9 will trigger the bonus armor from Prismatic Insignia.

skills.name: Glyph of Energy
skills.title: Glyph of Energy
skills.desc: Elite Glyph. Your next 1..3 spell[s] do[es] not cause Overcast and cost[s] 10..25 less Energy to cast. Your elemental attributes are increased by 1..2.

skills.name: Glyph of Lesser Energy
skills.title: Glyph of Lesser Energy
skills.desc: Glyph. For the next 15 seconds, your next 2 spells cost 10..18 less Energy to cast.

skills.name: Glyph of Concentration
skills.title: Glyph of Concentration
skills.desc: Glyph. For 15 seconds, your next 1 spell cannot be interrupted and ignores the effects of being Dazed.
notes: BUG: It is sometimes possible to be interrupted by a Destroyer of Deeds using Broad Head Arrow in Glint's Challenge or by the environment effect Cathedral Collapse in Arborstone while this glyph is still active.

skills.name: Glyph of Sacrifice
skills.title: Glyph of Sacrifice
skills.desc: Glyph. For 15 seconds, your next spell casts instantly, but it takes an additional 30 seconds to recharge. Ends prematurely if you use a non-spell skill.
notes: ANOMALY: Despite the descriptions saying that the next spell casts instantly, a better description would be very quickly, as the activation time of the spell cast through it is a 1/4 second and there's still a slight chance it might be interrupted.

skills.name: Glyph of Renewal
skills.title: Glyph of Renewal
skills.desc: Elite Glyph. For 15 seconds, your next spell instantly recharges.

skills.name: Rust
skills.title: Rust
skills.desc: Hex Spell. Deals 10..85 cold damage to target and adjacent foes. For 5..20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes take twice as long to activate signets. If you are Overcast, foes struck with Rust have their signets interrupted and disabled for 1..10 second[s].

skills.name: Lightning Surge
skills.title: Lightning Surge
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe is knocked down and struck for 14..100 lightning damage, and has Cracked Armor for 5..20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Armor of Frost
skills.title: Armor of Frost
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 10..34 seconds, you gain +40 armor against physical damage and have +1 Water Magic.

skills.name: Conjure Frost
skills.title: Conjure Frost
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a cold weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5..20 cold damage.

skills.name: Water Attunement
skills.title: Water Attunement
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 36..60 seconds, you are attuned to Water. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Water Magic.

skills.name: Ice Prison
skills.title: Ice Prison
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 8..20 seconds, target foe's legs are encased in ice, causing the foe to move 66% slower.

skills.name: Ice Spikes
skills.title: Ice Spikes
skills.desc: Hex Spell. Target and adjacent foes are struck for 20..80 cold damage and move 66% slower for 2..6 seconds.

skills.name: Frozen Burst
skills.title: Frozen Burst
skills.desc: Hex Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 10..85 cold damage and move 66% slower for 3..8 seconds.
notes: BUG: Some foes (notably Ice Elementals in pre-Searing) will sometimes overestimate this skill's range and use it while foes are slightly out of it.

skills.name: Shard Storm
skills.title: Shard Storm
skills.desc: Hex Spell. Send out an ice shard that strikes target foe for 10..85 cold damage if it hits and causing target foe to move 66% slower for 2..6 seconds.

skills.name: Ice Spear
skills.title: Ice Spear
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. Send out an Ice Spear, striking target foe for 10..60 cold damage if it hits. If you are Overcast, you gain +1..4 Health regeneration for 5 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to other enchantments that target a foe, foes affected by Well of the Profane or spirits cannot be targeted by this enchantment.

skills.name: Maelstrom
skills.title: Maelstrom
skills.desc: Spell. Create a Maelstrom at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, foes adjacent to that area are struck for 10..25 cold damage each second. Maelstrom interrupts spell-casting when it hits.

skills.name: Iron Mist
skills.title: Iron Mist
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 8..15 seconds, you have +15 armor. Your Air Magic spells that target a foe activate and recharge 33% faster, but you are Overcast by 2 points.
notes: BUG: The effects of this skill apply to all spells, regardless of target or attribute.

skills.name: Crystal Wave
skills.title: Crystal Wave
skills.desc: Spell. Foes adjacent to you are struck for 10..70 damage but are cured of any negative conditions. Each condition removed deals 5..15 damage.

skills.name: Obsidian Flesh
skills.title: Obsidian Flesh
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 8..20 seconds, you gain +20 armor and cannot be the target of enemy spells, but cannot attack and have -2 energy degeneration.
notes: BUG: The armor bonus from this skill only applies to physical damage.

skills.name: Blinding Flash
skills.title: Blinding Flash
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe is Blinded for 3..8 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: This skill can be used on a spirit but it will not inflict blindness.

skills.name: Conjure Lightning
skills.title: Conjure Lightning
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, if you're wielding a lightning weapon, your attacks strike for an additional 5..20 lightning damage.

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.title: Lightning Strike
skills.desc: Hex Spell. Strike target foe for 10..60 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If you are Overcast, that foe is hexed with Lightning Strike for 3 seconds. When this hex ends, that foe is struck again for 20..40 lightning damage.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to Incendiary Bonds and Lightning Surge, removing the hex before it ends will negate the end effect, unlike Shatterstone and most other skills with an end effect.
ANOMALY: Despite the ambiguity of the concise description, the end effect damage also has 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.title: Chain Lightning
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe and up to two other foes near your target are struck for 10..85 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Enervating Charge
skills.title: Enervating Charge
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe is struck for 25..50 lightning damage and suffers from Weakness for 5..20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Air Attunement
skills.title: Air Attunement
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 36..60 seconds, you are attuned to Air. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill whenever you use Air Magic.

skills.name: Glimmering Mark
skills.title: Glimmering Mark
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe and all foes adjacent to your target take 5..25 damage each second. Foes using attack skills are Blinded for 3 seconds. This hex ends if you use a skill that targets this foe.
notes: BUG: The concise description fails to specify the duration of the Blind condition
ANOMALY: Unlike most area damage over time skills, Glimmering Mark does not cause AI to scatter.

skills.name: Thunderclap
skills.title: Thunderclap
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Create a massive shockwave at target foe's location. Deals 10..50 lightning damage to target and all nearby foes. Struck foes are interrupted and suffer from Cracked Armor and Weakness for 5..20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Lightning Orb
skills.title: Lightning Orb
skills.desc: Spell. Send out a Lightning Orb that strikes target foe for 10..100 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Lightning Javelin
skills.title: Lightning Javelin
skills.desc: Spell. Send out a Lightning Javelin that strikes for 15..50 lightning damage if it hits. Lightning Javelin interrupts attacking foes. This spell has 25% armor penetration and strikes all foes between you and your target.

skills.name: Shock
skills.title: Shock
skills.desc: Skill. Target touched foe is knocked down and struck for 10..60 lightning damage. This skill has 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Lightning Touch
skills.title: Lightning Touch
skills.desc: Skill. Target touched foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 10..60 lightning damage, are Blinded for 1..4 second[s], and have Cracked Armor for 1..10 second[s]. This skill has 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Swirling Aura
skills.title: Swirling Aura
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 3..7 second[s], you are enchanted with Swirling Aura and have 1..6 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block projectiles. If you are Overcast when you cast this spell, all party members in earshot are also enchanted.

skills.name: Deep Freeze
skills.title: Deep Freeze
skills.desc: Hex Spell. You cause a Deep Freeze at target foe's location. All foes in this area are struck for 10..85 cold damage, and for 10 seconds, they move 66% slower.

skills.name: Blurred Vision
skills.title: Blurred Vision
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 4..10 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes are hexed with Blurred Vision. While hexed, those foes have a 50% chance to miss with attacks.

skills.name: Water Trident
skills.title: Water Trident
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Send out a fast-moving Water Trident, striking target foe and up to 2 adjacent foes for 10..90 cold damage if it hits. If it hits a moving foe, that foe is knocked down.

skills.name: Armor of Mist
skills.title: Armor of Mist
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 8..20 seconds, you gain +10..40 armor and move 33% faster.

skills.name: Smite
skills.title: Smite
skills.desc: Spell. This attack deals 10..55 Holy damage. If attacking, your target takes an additional 10..35 Holy damage.

skills.name: Life Bond
skills.title: Life Bond
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target other ally takes damage from an attack, half the damage is redirected to you. The damage you receive this way is reduced by 3..30.

skills.name: Balthazar's Spirit
skills.title: Balthazar's Spirit
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally gains adrenaline and 1 Energy after taking damage. (The amount of adrenaline gained increases depending on your rank in Smiting Prayers.)

skills.name: Life Attunement
skills.title: Life Attunement
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally deals 30% less damage with attacks, but gains 14..50% more Health when healed.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to Flurry, the damage reduction only applies to the equipped weapon's base damage. It will not reduce damage dealt by skills or effects, not even bonus damage from attack skills.

skills.name: Protective Spirit
skills.title: Protective Spirit
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..23 seconds, target ally cannot lose more than 10% max Health due to damage from a single attack or spell.

skills.name: Divine Intervention
skills.title: Divine Intervention
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, the next time target ally receives damage that would be fatal, the damage is negated and that ally is healed for 26..240 Health.
notes: BUG: This skill does not prevent damage; rather, it heals the enchanted target to the stated amount when they would die.

skills.name: Symbol of Wrath
skills.title: Symbol of Wrath
skills.desc: Spell. Create a Symbol of Wrath at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, adjacent foes are struck for 10..40 holy damage each second.
notes: BUG: While the functionality of this spell has changed with the June 24, 2026 update, its animation has not. There is no visible animation to highlight the new area of effect.
BUG: Contrary to other skills dealing Area damage over time (such as Fire Storm), this skill will fail if the target dies before the spell finishes casting.

skills.name: Retribution
skills.title: Retribution
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target ally takes attack damage, this spell deals 33% of the damage back to the source (maximum 5..20 damage).
notes: BUG: If you somehow manage to maintain Retribution on a foe, it will not deal damage back to you or your allies.

skills.name: Holy Wrath
skills.title: Holy Wrath
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 10..30 seconds, the next 1..10 time[s] target other ally takes attack damage, this spell deals 66% of the damage back to the source (maximum of 5..50 damage).

skills.name: Essence Bond
skills.title: Essence Bond
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, whenever target ally takes physical or elemental damage, you gain 1 Energy.

skills.name: Scourge Healing
skills.title: Scourge Healing
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, every time target foe is healed, the healer takes 15..80 holy damage.
notes: ANOMALY: This hex does not trigger for Heal Area, Karei's Healing Circle, and Healing Ring.

skills.name: Banish
skills.title: Banish
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe takes 20..65 holy damage. This spell does double damage to summoned creatures.

skills.name: Scourge Sacrifice
skills.title: Scourge Sacrifice
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 8..20 seconds, every time target foe and adjacent foes sacrifice life, they sacrifice twice the normal amount.

skills.name: Vigorous Spirit
skills.title: Vigorous Spirit
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, each time target ally attacks or casts a spell, that ally is healed for 5..20 Health.
notes: ANOMALY: Empathy triggers on failed attack skills, whereas Vigorous Spirit does not.

skills.name: Watchful Spirit
skills.title: Watchful Spirit
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally gains +2 Health regeneration. That ally is healed for 30..180 Health when Watchful Spirit ends.
notes: BUG: End effect healing is not affected by Unyielding Aura.

skills.name: Blessed Aura
skills.title: Blessed Aura
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, Monk enchantments you cast last 10..35% longer.

skills.name: Guardian
skills.title: Guardian
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 2..7 seconds, target ally has a 50% chance to block attacks.
