skills.name: Barrage
skills.title: Barrage
skills.desc: Elite Bow Attack. All your preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 5 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +5..20 damage if they hit.

skills.name: Dual Shot
skills.title: Dual Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. Shoot two arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 25% less damage.

skills.name: Quick Shot
skills.title: Quick Shot
skills.desc: Elite Bow Attack. Shoot an arrow that moves twice as fast.

skills.name: Distracting Shot
skills.title: Distracting Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. If Distracting Shot hits, it interrupts target foe's action but deals only 1..16 damage. If the interrupted action was a skill, that skill is disabled for an additional 20 seconds.

skills.name: Precision Shot
skills.title: Precision Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. If Precision Shot hits, you strike for +3..10 damage. Precision Shot cannot be blocked. This action is easily interrupted.

skills.name: Determined Shot
skills.title: Determined Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. If Determined Shot hits, you strike for +5..20 damage. If Determined Shot fails to hit, all of your attack skills are recharged.

skills.name: Called Shot
skills.title: Called Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. Shoot an arrow that moves 3 times faster and cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Poison Arrow
skills.title: Poison Arrow
skills.desc: Elite Bow Attack. If Poison Arrow hits, your target becomes Poisoned for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Oath Shot
skills.title: Oath Shot
skills.desc: Elite Bow Attack. If Oath Shot hits, all of your skills except Oath Shot are recharged. If it misses, all of your skills are disabled for 10..4 seconds. (50% miss chance with Expertise 7 or less.)

skills.name: Debilitating Shot
skills.title: Debilitating Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. If Debilitating Shot hits, your target loses 1..10 Energy.

skills.name: Point Blank Shot
skills.title: Point Blank Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. Shoot an arrow that has half the normal range, but strikes for +10..40 damage.

skills.name: Concussion Shot
skills.title: Concussion Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. If Concussion Shot hits while target foe is casting a spell, the spell is interrupted and your target is Dazed for 5..20 seconds. This attack deals only 1..16 damage.
notes: BUG: This skill does not interrupt spells; the application of daze does: if the daze is not applied (i.e. if the target is enchanted by Infuse Condition and has a minion to transfer the daze to), no interrupt will occur.

skills.name: Punishing Shot
skills.title: Punishing Shot
skills.desc: Elite Bow Attack. If Punishing Shot hits, you strike for +10..20 damage and your target is interrupted.

skills.name: Charm Animal
skills.title: Charm Animal
skills.desc: Skill. Charm target animal. Once charmed, your animal companion will travel with you whenever you have Charm Animal equipped. You cannot charm an animal that is more than 4 levels above you.
notes: ANOMALY: Although technically considered a pet, occasionally a charmed animal will retain the red wording associated with a hostile enemy just after completing the charm animal skill.

skills.name: Call of Protection
skills.title: Call of Protection
skills.desc: Shout. For 120 seconds, your animal companion has a 5..20 base damage reduction.

skills.name: Revive Animal
skills.title: Revive Animal
skills.desc: Skill. Resurrect all nearby allied animal companions. They come back to life with 10..94% Health.

skills.name: Symbiotic Bond
skills.title: Symbiotic Bond
skills.desc: Shout. For 120..300 seconds, your animal companion gains 1..3 Health regeneration, and half of all damage dealt to your animal companion is redirected to you.
notes: BUG: Upon reconnecting from a disconnect when having this skill active it will appear as a maintained enchantment. (See the discussion page for more information and screenshots.)

skills.name: Throw Dirt
skills.title: Throw Dirt
skills.desc: Skill. Target touched foe and foes adjacent to your target become Blinded for 3..15 seconds.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.title: Dodge
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..11 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 27..75% chance to block incoming projectiles. Dodge ends if you attack.

skills.name: Savage Shot
skills.title: Savage Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. If Savage Shot hits, your target's action is interrupted. If that action was a spell, you strike for +13..28 damage.

skills.name: Antidote Signet
skills.title: Antidote Signet
skills.desc: Signet. Cleanse yourself of Poison, Disease, and Blindness, and one additional condition.

skills.name: Incendiary Arrows
skills.title: Incendiary Arrows
skills.desc: Elite Bow Attack. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 2 foes near your target. Those foes are set on fire for 1..3 second[s].

skills.name: Melandru's Arrows
skills.title: Melandru's Arrows
skills.desc: Elite Preparation. For 18 seconds, whenever your arrows hit, they cause Bleeding for 3..25 seconds, and if they hit a target who is under an enchantment, they do +8..28 damage.

skills.name: Marksman's Wager
skills.title: Marksman's Wager
skills.desc: Elite Preparation. For 18 seconds, you gain 5..10 Energy whenever your arrows hit, but lose 10 Energy whenever your arrows fail to strike.

skills.name: Ignite Arrows
skills.title: Ignite Arrows
skills.desc: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your arrows explode on contact, dealing 3..18 fire damage to target and all adjacent foes.

skills.name: Kindle Arrows
skills.title: Kindle Arrows
skills.desc: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your arrows deal fire damage and hit for an additional 3..24 fire damage.

skills.name: Choking Gas
skills.title: Choking Gas
skills.desc: Preparation. For 1..12 seconds, your arrows deal 1..8 more damage and spread Choking Gas to all adjacent foes on impact. Choking Gas interrupts foes attempting to cast spells.

skills.name: Apply Poison
skills.title: Apply Poison
skills.desc: Preparation. For 24 seconds, foes struck by your physical attacks become Poisoned for 3..15 seconds.
notes: BUG: Heroes wielding a ranged weapon will target swap to new unpoisoned targets, but will not attack already poisoned ones.

skills.name: Bestial Pounce
skills.title: Bestial Pounce
skills.desc: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Bestial Pounce that deals +5..20 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is casting a spell, that foe is knocked down.

skills.name: Maiming Strike
skills.title: Maiming Strike
skills.desc: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Maiming Strike that deals +5..20 damage. If that attack hits that foe becomes Crippled for 3..15 seconds.

skills.name: Feral Lunge
skills.title: Feral Lunge
skills.desc: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Feral Lunge that deals +5..35 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is attacking, that foe suffers from Bleeding for 5..25 seconds.

skills.name: Scavenger Strike
skills.title: Scavenger Strike
skills.desc: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Scavenger Strike that deals +10..25 damage. If the attack strikes a foe who is suffering a condition, you gain 3..15 Energy.

skills.name: Ferocious Strike
skills.title: Ferocious Strike
skills.desc: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Ferocious Strike that deals +13..28 damage. If that attack hits, you gain adrenaline and 3..10 Energy.

skills.name: Predator's Pounce
skills.title: Predator's Pounce
skills.desc: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Predator's Pounce that deals +5..35 damage. If that attack hits, your animal companion gains 5..50 Health.

skills.name: Brutal Strike
skills.title: Brutal Strike
skills.desc: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Brutal Strike that deals +5..35 damage. If that attack strikes a foe whose Health is below 50%, that foe takes an additional +5..35 damage.

skills.name: Disrupting Lunge
skills.title: Disrupting Lunge
skills.desc: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Disrupting Lunge that deals +1..12 damage. If that attack strikes a foe using a skill that skill is interrupted and is disabled for an additional 20 seconds.

skills.name: Troll Unguent
skills.title: Troll Unguent
skills.desc: Skill. For 13 seconds, you gain +3..10 Health regeneration.

skills.name: Practiced Stance
skills.title: Practiced Stance
skills.desc: Elite Stance. For 20..35 seconds, your Preparations recharge 50% faster and last 30..300% longer.

skills.name: Whirling Defense
skills.title: Whirling Defense
skills.desc: Stance. For 8..20 seconds, you have 75% chance to block attacks. Whenever you block a projectile in this way, adjacent foes take 5..11 damage.
notes: ANOMALY: Although the damage is nondescript, it does trigger Mark of Pain and Winnowing, making it armor-ignoring physical damage.
BUG: The non-concise description is wrong, this skill will deal damage even if the projectile is blocked from another blocking source.

skills.name: Melandru's Resilience
skills.title: Melandru's Resilience
skills.desc: Elite Stance. For 8..20 seconds, you gain +4 Health regeneration and +1 Energy regeneration for each condition and hex you are suffering.

skills.name: Dryder's Defenses
skills.title: Dryder's Defenses
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..11 seconds, you gain 75% chance to block attacks and 34..60 armor against elemental damage.

skills.name: Tiger's Fury
skills.title: Tiger's Fury
skills.desc: Stance. All your non-attack skills are disabled for 5 seconds. For 5..11 seconds, you attack 25% faster.

skills.name: Storm Chaser
skills.title: Storm Chaser
skills.desc: Stance. For 8..20 seconds, you move 25% faster, and you gain 1..5 Energy whenever you take elemental damage.

skills.name: Serpent's Quickness
skills.title: Serpent's Quickness
skills.desc: Stance. For 15..30 seconds, recharge times for your skills are reduced by 33%. Serpent's Quickness ends if your Health drops below 50%.

skills.name: Dust Trap
skills.title: Dust Trap
skills.desc: Trap. When Dust Trap is triggered, every second (for 5 seconds total), all nearby foes are Blinded for 3..8 seconds and take 10..25 damage. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted. Dust Trap ends after 90 seconds.
notes: BUG: The damage dealt is armor-ignoring earth damage.

skills.name: Barbed Trap
skills.title: Barbed Trap
skills.desc: Trap. When Barbed Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 7..23 piercing damage, become Crippled, and begin Bleeding for 3..25 seconds. Barbed Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

skills.name: Flame Trap
skills.title: Flame Trap
skills.desc: Trap. When Flame Trap is triggered, every second (for 3 seconds total), all nearby foes are struck for 5..20 fire damage and set on fire for 1..3 second[s]. Flame Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

skills.name: Healing Spring
skills.title: Healing Spring
skills.desc: Trap. For 10 seconds, all adjacent allies are healed for 15..60 every 2 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
notes: BUG: Although allied spirits will display this skill's animation effect, they will not be healed (since spirits are never affected by healing).

skills.name: Spike Trap
skills.title: Spike Trap
skills.desc: Elite Trap. When Spike Trap is triggered, every second (for 2 seconds), all nearby foes are struck for 10..40 piercing damage, become Crippled for 3..25 seconds, and are knocked down. Spike Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

skills.name: Winter
skills.title: Winter
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. For creatures within its range, all elemental damage is cold damage instead. This spirit dies after 30..240 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike Greater Conflagration or Conflagration this skill requires either the attacker or the damage receiver to be inside the spirit area of effect.

skills.name: Winnowing
skills.title: Winnowing
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within range take 4 additional damage whenever they take physical damage. This spirit dies after 30..240 seconds.
notes: BUG: Contrary to the full description, creatures in range deal +4 damage, not receive. This means that all creatures, including spirits, do take +4 damage.

skills.name: Edge of Extinction
skills.title: Edge of Extinction
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. If a non-spirit creature within range dies, Edge of Extinction deals 14..50 damage to all creatures of the same type that are below 90% Health and within range of the spirit. This spirit dies after 30..240 seconds.

skills.name: Greater Conflagration
skills.title: Greater Conflagration
skills.desc: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all physical damage is fire damage instead. This spirit dies after 30..240 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike Winter this skill requires the attacker to be inside the spirit area of effect.

BUG: Does not properly convert the physical damage of certain skills (notably: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support and Veil of Thorns). As a result, the skill chain will not trigger the conditional effects of other skills that depend on fire damage (in particular, for Intensity).

skills.name: Conflagration
skills.title: Conflagration
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all arrows that hit strike for fire damage. This spirit dies after 30..240 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: This spirit also causes Bone Fiend attacks and spear attacks to strike with fire damage.
ANOMALY: Unlike Winter, this skill requires the attacker to be inside the spirit area of effect.

skills.name: Fertile Season
skills.title: Fertile Season
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within range have +50..150 maximum Health and gain +8 armor. This spirit dies after 15..90 seconds.

skills.name: Symbiosis
skills.title: Symbiosis
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. For each enchantment on a non-spirit creature within range, that creature has +27..150 maximum Health. This spirit dies after 30..240 seconds.

skills.name: Primal Echoes
skills.title: Primal Echoes
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 Spirit. For non-Spirit creatures within its range, Signets cost 10 Energy to use. This Spirit dies after 30..240 seconds.

skills.name: Predatory Season
skills.title: Predatory Season
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all healing is reduced by 20%. If any of your attacks hit, you gain 5 Health. This spirit dies after 30..240 seconds.

skills.name: Frozen Soil
skills.title: Frozen Soil
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range cannot activate resurrection skills. This spirit dies after 30..180 seconds.
notes: BUG: Eternal Aura can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.

skills.name: Favorable Winds
skills.title: Favorable Winds
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, arrows move twice as fast and strike for +6 damage. This spirit dies after 30..240 seconds.

skills.name: Energizing Wind
skills.title: Energizing Wind
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..6 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all skills cost 15 less Energy (minimum cost 10 Energy), and skills recharge 25% slower. This spirit dies after 1..60 second[s].

skills.name: Quickening Zephyr
skills.title: Quickening Zephyr
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. For non-spirit creatures within its range, all skills recharge twice as fast and cost 30% more of the base Energy to cast. This spirit dies after 15..90 seconds.

skills.name: Muddy Terrain
skills.title: Muddy Terrain
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range move 10% slower and speed boosts have no effect. This spirit dies after 30..180 seconds.

skills.name: Mark of Insecurity
skills.title: Mark of Insecurity
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 5..25 seconds, target foe suffers from -1..5 Health degeneration, and enchantments and stances on target foe expire 20..60% faster. All of your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Disrupting Dagger
skills.title: Disrupting Dagger
skills.desc: Spell. Send out a Disrupting Dagger at target foe that strikes for 10..35 earth damage. If that foe was activating a skill, that skill is interrupted. This spell has half the normal range.

skills.name: Deadly Paradox
skills.title: Deadly Paradox
skills.desc: Stance. All of your attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds. For 5..15 seconds, your Assassin skills activate and recharge 33% faster.
notes: BUG: Similar to Migraine, this skill does not decrease the activation time of dagger attack skills. Recharge time of dagger attack skills are affected as the skill describes.

skills.name: Jaundiced Gaze
skills.title: Jaundiced Gaze
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, for the next 1..20 second[s], your next enchantment spell casts 0..1 second[s] faster and costs 1..10 less Energy.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to other enchantments that target a foe, foes affected by Well of the Profane or spirits cannot be targeted by this enchantment.

skills.name: Wail of Doom
skills.title: Wail of Doom
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 2..6 second[s], all of target foe's attributes are set to 0.

skills.name: Gaze of Contempt
skills.title: Gaze of Contempt
skills.desc: Spell. If target foe has more than 50% Health, that foe loses all enchantments.

skills.name: Viper's Defense
skills.title: Viper's Defense
skills.desc: Spell. All adjacent foes are Poisoned for 5..20 seconds. Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.
notes: ANOMALY: This spell does not have an aftercast delay.

skills.name: Return
skills.title: Return
skills.desc: Spell. All adjacent foes are Crippled for 3..8 seconds. Shadow Step to target other ally's location.
notes: ANOMALY: This spell does not have an aftercast delay.

skills.name: Aura of Displacement
skills.title: Aura of Displacement
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. When you cast Aura of Displacement, Shadow Step to target foe. When you stop maintaining Aura of Displacement you return to your original location.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to other enchantments that target a foe, foes affected by Well of the Profane or spirits cannot be targeted by this enchantment.

skills.name: Generous Was Tsungrai
skills.title: Generous Was Tsungrai
skills.desc: Item Spell. Hold Tsungrai's ashes for up to 15..60 seconds and gain +50..140 maximum Health. When you drop his ashes, you gain 100..280 Health.

skills.name: Mighty Was Vorizun
skills.title: Mighty Was Vorizun
skills.desc: Item Spell. Hold Vorizun's ashes for up to 15..60 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you gain +15 armor and +30 maximum Energy.

skills.name: Twisting Fangs
skills.title: Twisting Fangs
skills.desc: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Twisting Fangs strikes for +10..20 damage and struck foe suffers from Bleeding and Deep Wound for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Horns of the Ox
skills.title: Horns of the Ox
skills.desc: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Horns of the Ox strikes for +1..11 damage. If struck foe is not adjacent to any allies, that foe is knocked down.

skills.name: Falling Spider
skills.title: Falling Spider
skills.desc: Off-Hand Attack. Must strike a knocked-down foe. If it hits, Falling Spider strikes for +15..35 damage and target foe is Poisoned for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Black Lotus Strike
skills.title: Black Lotus Strike
skills.desc: Lead Attack. If it hits, Black Lotus Strike strikes for +10..31 damage. If target foe is suffering from a Hex, you gain 5..13 Energy.

skills.name: Moebius Strike
skills.title: Moebius Strike
skills.desc: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a Dual Attack. If it hits, Moebius Strike strikes for +10..35 damage. If you strike a foe whose Health is below 50%, all your other attack skills are recharged.

skills.name: Jagged Strike
skills.title: Jagged Strike
skills.desc: Lead Attack. If Jagged Strike hits, your target suffers from Bleeding for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Unsuspecting Strike
skills.title: Unsuspecting Strike
skills.desc: Lead Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +19..31 damage. If your target was above 90% Health you deal an additional 15..75 damage.

skills.name: Entangling Asp
skills.title: Entangling Asp
skills.desc: Spell. Entangling Asp must follow a lead attack. Target foe is knocked down and becomes Poisoned for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Mark of Death
skills.title: Mark of Death
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 4..10 seconds, target foe gains 50% less benefit from healing.

skills.name: Iron Palm
skills.title: Iron Palm
skills.desc: Skill. Target touched foe suffers 5..50 damage, and if that foe is suffering from a hex or condition that foe is knocked down. Iron Palm counts as a lead attack.

skills.name: Resilient Weapon
skills.title: Resilient Weapon
skills.desc: Weapon Spell. For 3..12 seconds, target ally has a Resilient Weapon. While suffering from a hex or condition, that ally gains +1..6 Health regeneration and +24 armor.

skills.name: Blind Was Mingson
skills.title: Blind Was Mingson
skills.desc: Item Spell. Hold Mingson's ashes for up to 15..60 seconds. When you drop his ashes, all nearby foes are Blinded for 3..8 seconds.

skills.name: Grasping Was Kuurong
skills.title: Grasping Was Kuurong
skills.desc: Elite Item Spell. Hold Kuurong's ashes for up to 15..60 seconds. When you drop his ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15..75 damage and knocked down.

skills.name: Vengeful Was Khanhei
skills.title: Vengeful Was Khanhei
skills.desc: Elite Item Spell. Hold Khanhei's ashes for 5..11 seconds. Whenever a foe strikes you in combat while you are holding Khanhei's ashes, you steal 10..45 Health from that foe.

skills.name: Wailing Weapon
skills.title: Wailing Weapon
skills.desc: Weapon Spell. For 3..14 seconds, target ally has a Wailing Weapon. Whenever the Wailing Weapon strikes an attacking foe, that foe is interrupted.

skills.name: Nightmare Weapon
skills.title: Nightmare Weapon
skills.desc: Weapon Spell. For 12 seconds, target ally has a Nightmare Weapon. Target ally's next 3 attacks are reduced by 10..50 damage and steal up to 10..50 Health.

skills.name: Beguiling Haze
skills.title: Beguiling Haze
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. That foe becomes Dazed for 3..9 seconds.

skills.name: Enduring Toxin
skills.title: Enduring Toxin
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, target foe suffers -1..5 Health degeneration. If that foe is moving when Enduring Toxin would end, Enduring Toxin is renewed for another 5 seconds.

skills.name: Shroud of Silence
skills.title: Shroud of Silence
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. All of your spells are disabled for 15 seconds. For 1..6 second[s], target touched foe cannot cast spells.

skills.name: Expose Defenses
skills.title: Expose Defenses
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 1..11 second[s], target foe cannot block your attacks.

skills.name: Power Leech
skills.title: Power Leech
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and for 10 seconds, whenever that foe casts a spell, you steal up to 5..15 Energy from that foe.

skills.name: Arcane Languor
skills.title: Arcane Languor
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 1..10 second[s], all spells cast by the target foe cause 10 Overcast.

skills.name: Animate Vampiric Horror
skills.title: Animate Vampiric Horror
skills.desc: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to animate a level 1..17 Vampiric Horror. Whenever a Vampiric Horror you control deals damage, you gain the same amount of Health.

skills.name: Cultist's Fervor
skills.title: Cultist's Fervor
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds and 3 seconds longer for every rank of Soul Reaping, your Necromancer spells cost -1..6 Energy to cast but you suffer from Bleeding for 10 seconds each time you cast a Necromancer spell.
notes: ANOMALY: Causes bleeding when non-fleshy creatures, such as Shadow Vaettirs, cast Necromancer spells.

skills.name: Reaper's Mark
skills.title: Reaper's Mark
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe suffers -1..5 Health degeneration. If that foe dies while hexed with Reaper's Mark, you gain 5..15 Energy.

skills.name: Shatterstone
skills.title: Shatterstone
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe is struck for 25..100 cold damage, moves 66% slower, and is hexed with Shatterstone for 3 seconds. When Shatterstone ends, that foe and all nearby foes are struck for 25..100 cold damage.

skills.name: Run as One
skills.title: Run as One
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..15 seconds, you and your pet run 25% faster.

skills.name: Defiant Was Xinrae
skills.title: Defiant Was Xinrae
skills.desc: Elite Item Spell. Hold Xinrae's ashes for up to 15..60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, you cannot lose more than 20% of your max Health from a single hit. When you drop her ashes, you steal 5..50 Health from all nearby foes.

skills.name: Lyssa's Aura
skills.title: Lyssa's Aura
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, you have +0..5 Energy regeneration. This enchantment reapplies itself every time you cast a spell on a foe.

skills.name: Shadow Refuge
skills.title: Shadow Refuge
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 6 seconds, you gain 5..10 Health regeneration. When Shadow Refuge ends, you gain 40..100 Health if you are attacking.
notes: BUG: Contrary to the full description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.

skills.name: Scorpion Wire
skills.title: Scorpion Wire
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 8..20 seconds, the next time you and target foe are more than 75' apart, you Shadow Step to that foe and that foe is knocked down. This spell has half the normal range.

skills.name: Mirrored Stance
skills.title: Mirrored Stance
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 10..35 seconds, whenever target foe enters a stance, you enter the same stance.
notes: ANOMALY: If the copied stance has an initial effect, the initial effect will not affect you. I.e. Bestial Fury/Tiger's Fury, Deadly Paradox, and Shadow Walk will not disable your skills; Shadow Walk will also not cause you to shadow step to a foe.

skills.name: Well of Weariness
skills.title: Well of Weariness
skills.desc: Well Spell. Exploit target corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Weariness for 10..55 seconds. Enemies within the Well of Weariness suffer -1 Energy degeneration.

skills.name: Vampiric Spirit
skills.title: Vampiric Spirit
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. Steal up to 15..60 Health from target foe. For 10 seconds, you have +5..10 Health regeneration.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to other enchantments that target a foe, foes affected by Well of the Profane or spirits cannot be targeted by this enchantment.

skills.name: Depravity
skills.title: Depravity
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 5..20 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, that foe and one nearby foe lose 1..5 Energy.

skills.name: Icy Veins
skills.title: Icy Veins
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe is struck for 10..90 cold damage. For 10..35 seconds, if target foe dies all nearby foes are struck for 20..110 cold damage.

skills.name: Weaken Knees
skills.title: Weaken Knees
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. For 1..16 second[s], target foe suffers -1..4 Health degeneration and takes 5..20 damage while moving.

skills.name: Burning Speed
skills.title: Burning Speed
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 7 seconds, you are set on fire and move 30..45% faster. When Burning Speed ends, all adjacent foes are set on fire for 3..9 seconds.

skills.name: Lava Arrows
skills.title: Lava Arrows
skills.desc: Spell. Lava Arrows fly toward up to 3 foes near your target and strike for 20..65 fire damage if they hit.

skills.name: Bed of Coals
