skills.name: Spirit Boon Strike
skills.title: Spirit Boon Strike
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe is struck for 20..65 lightning damage, and all spirits you control within earshot gain 20..65 Health.

skills.name: Essence Strike
skills.title: Essence Strike
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe is struck for 15..60 lightning damage. If any spirits are within earshot, you gain 1..9 Energy.

skills.name: Spirit Siphon
skills.title: Spirit Siphon
skills.desc: Spell. The spirit nearest you loses all Energy. You gain 30..60% of that Energy.

skills.name: Explosive Growth
skills.title: Explosive Growth
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 15..60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, up to 5 foes near that creature are struck for 20..65 lightning damage.

skills.name: Boon of Creation
skills.title: Boon of Creation
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 15..60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, you gain 5..50 Health and 1..6 Energy.
notes: BUG: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.

skills.name: Spirit Channeling
skills.title: Spirit Channeling
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 12 seconds, you have +1..6 Energy regeneration. When you cast this spell, you gain 3..12 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit.

skills.name: Soothing Memories
skills.title: Soothing Memories
skills.desc: Spell. Target ally is healed for 10..100 Health. If you are holding an item, you gain 3 Energy.

skills.name: Mend Body and Soul
skills.title: Mend Body and Soul
skills.desc: Spell. Target ally is healed for 20..115 Health. That ally loses one condition for each spirit within earshot.
notes: ANOMALY: While most other ally targeted Restoration Magic spells cast a unique visual effect on the target, Mend Body and Soul places a unique visual effect on the caster instead.

skills.name: Dulled Weapon
skills.title: Dulled Weapon
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5..20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes cannot achieve a critical hit and deal 3..20 less damage.
notes: ANOMALY: This hex only reduces damage from attacks.

skills.name: Binding Chains
skills.title: Binding Chains
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 3 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes move 90% slower and take 1..30 damage each second while moving.

skills.name: Painful Bond
skills.title: Painful Bond
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 10..20 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes are hexed with Painful Bond and take 8..20 damage whenever hit by a spirit's attack.
notes: BUG: The concise description incorrectly states that spirits do more damage; it is the hex causing the damage and spirits that do not deal damage with its attacks (i.e. Bloodsong, Vampirism, and Wanderlust) do not technically deal more damage. Spirits that deal damage without attacking (e.g. Destruction) don't get their damage increased by Painful Bond.

skills.name: Signet of Creation
skills.title: Signet of Creation
skills.desc: Signet. You gain 4 Energy for every summoned creature you control within earshot (maximum 3..12 Energy).

skills.name: Ghostly Haste
skills.title: Ghostly Haste
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..30 seconds, spells you cast while within earshot of a spirit recharge 25% faster.

skills.name: Gaze from Beyond
skills.title: Gaze from Beyond
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe is struck for 20..65 lightning damage. If you are within earshot of a spirit, that foe is Blinded for 2..6 seconds.

skills.name: Spirit Light Weapon
skills.title: Spirit Light Weapon
skills.desc: Elite Weapon Spell. For 10 seconds, target ally gains 5..25 Health per second and an additional 5..25 Health per second if that ally is within earshot of a spirit.
notes: BUG: Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.

skills.name: Brutal Weapon
skills.title: Brutal Weapon
skills.desc: Weapon Spell. Give target ally a Brutal Weapon for 10..40 seconds. The bearer's weapon strikes for +5..15 damage as long as the bearer is under no enchantments.

skills.name: Meekness
skills.title: Meekness
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5..30 seconds, target foe and all foes in the area attack 50% slower.

skills.name: Frigid Armor
skills.title: Frigid Armor
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 10..25 seconds, you have +10..40 armor against physical damage and cannot be set on fire.
notes: ANOMALY: This skill does not remove existing Burning, unlike other skills that grant immunity to a condition (e.g. Tainted Flesh removes Disease).

skills.name: Healing Ring
skills.title: Healing Ring
skills.desc: Spell. Heal adjacent creatures for 30..180 Health. The caster is not healed.

skills.name: Renew Life
skills.title: Renew Life
skills.desc: Spell. Resurrect target touched dead target party member with 50% Health and 5..20% Energy. That party member and all allies within earshot are healed for 55..130 Health.

skills.name: Doom
skills.title: Doom
skills.desc: Spell. Strike target foe for 10..60 lightning (maximum 135) damage for every recharging binding ritual you have.

skills.name: Wielder's Boon
skills.title: Wielder's Boon
skills.desc: Spell. Heal target ally for 15..60 points. If that ally is under the effects of a weapon spell, Wielder's Boon heals for an additional 15..75 Health.

skills.name: Vital Weapon
skills.title: Vital Weapon
skills.desc: Weapon Spell. For 5..30 seconds, target ally has a Vital Weapon and has +40..175 maximum Health.

skills.name: Weapon of Quickening
skills.title: Weapon of Quickening
skills.desc: Elite Weapon Spell. For 5..25 seconds, target ally has a Weapon of Quickening, and spells and binding rituals recharge 33% faster.

skills.name: Signet of Rage
skills.title: Signet of Rage
skills.desc: Signet. Target foe takes 5..50 holy damage and +5..10 holy damage for each adrenaline skill that foe has.

skills.name: Extend Conditions
skills.title: Extend Conditions
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Spread all conditions from target foe to foes near your target. The durations of those conditions are increased by 5..100% (maximum 30 seconds).

skills.name: Hypochondria
skills.title: Hypochondria
skills.desc: Spell. Transfer all conditions from all foes in the area to target foe.

skills.name: Wastrel's Demise
skills.title: Wastrel's Demise
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, target foe is hexed with Wastrel's Demise. Each second while hexed, target foe and all foes adjacent to that foe take 1..10 damage and an additional 1..10 damage for each second this spell is in effect. This hex ends prematurely if target foe uses a skill.
notes: ANOMALY: If the hex is reapplied before it ends, Wastrel's Demise will continue to add up the bonus damage until the first hex would have run out. After that, the bonus damage cycle will start over.
ANOMALY: Unlike most area damage over time skills, Wastrel's Demise does not cause AI to scatter.

skills.name: Drain Delusions
skills.title: Drain Delusions
skills.desc: Spell. Remove one Mesmer hex from target foe. If a hex was removed in this way, that foe loses 1..5 Energy and you gain 4 Energy for each point lost.

skills.name: Persistence of Memory
skills.title: Persistence of Memory
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..20 seconds, whenever a spell you cast is interrupted, that spell is instantly recharged.

skills.name: Symbols of Inspiration
skills.title: Symbols of Inspiration
skills.desc: Elite Skill. For 6..40 seconds, this skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.

skills.name: Symbolic Celerity
skills.title: Symbolic Celerity
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 36..60 seconds, all of your signets use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
notes: ANOMALY: Items that grant a 20% chance of adding +1 to Fast Casting do not affect signets that are cast while this enchantment is active. For example, you cannot use "Master of My Domain" to obtain rank 21 in the table above. Instead, other signets will use the unmodified FC rank.

skills.name: Ether Phantom
skills.title: Ether Phantom
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe has -1 Energy degeneration. If this hex is removed prematurely, that foe loses 1..5 Energy.
notes: BUG: Ether Phantom stacks with itself causing multiple energy loss when removed prematurely

skills.name: Signet of Illusions
skills.title: Signet of Illusions
skills.desc: Elite Signet. Your next 1..3 non-Illusion spell[s] use your Illusion attribute instead of its normal attribute.
notes: ANOMALY: Items that grant a 20% chance of adding +1 to Illusion Magic do not affect spells cast while this signet is active. For example, you cannot use "Master of My Domain" to obtain rank 21 in the table above. Instead, spells will use the unmodified Illusion rank.

skills.name: Discharge Enchantment
skills.title: Discharge Enchantment
skills.desc: Spell. Remove one enchantment from target foe. If that foe is hexed, this skill recharges 20..50% faster.

skills.name: Hex Eater Vortex
skills.title: Hex Eater Vortex
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Remove a hex from target ally. If a hex is removed in this way, foes in the area of that ally take 30..90 damage and lose one enchantment.

skills.name: Simple Thievery
skills.title: Simple Thievery
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Interrupt target foe's action. If that action was a skill, that skill is disabled for 5..20 seconds, and Simple Thievery is replaced by that skill.

skills.name: Animate Shambling Horror
skills.title: Animate Shambling Horror
skills.desc: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to create a level 1..17 shambling horror. When the shambling horror dies, it is replaced by a level 0..15 jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks.
notes: ANOMALY: The descriptions do not mention the duration of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.

skills.name: Order of Undeath
skills.title: Order of Undeath
skills.desc: Elite Spell. For 5 seconds, your minions deal +3..16 damage, but you lose 2% of your maximum Health whenever one of your minions hits with an attack.
notes: BUG: This skill can not be cast if you are targeting someone under Spell Breaker, Vow of Silence etc. and triggers the spell Mistrust, acting like a target foe spell.

skills.name: Putrid Flesh
skills.title: Putrid Flesh
skills.desc: Spell. Destroy one of your target animated undead minions. All foes near that creature are Diseased for 5..15 seconds.

skills.name: Feast for the Dead
skills.title: Feast for the Dead
skills.desc: Spell. Destroy target animated undead ally. All of your other animated undead allies are healed for 10..100 Health.

skills.name: Jagged Bones
skills.title: Jagged Bones
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever target undead servant dies, it is replaced by a level 0..15 jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks.
notes: ANOMALY: The descriptions do not mention the duration of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.

skills.name: Contagion
skills.title: Contagion
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever you suffer from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that same condition and you sacrifice 10..5% maximum Health.

skills.name: Ulcerous Lungs
skills.title: Ulcerous Lungs
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 10..30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer from -4 Health degeneration when Bleeding, and whenever they use a shout or chant, they Bleed for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Pain of Disenchantment
skills.title: Pain of Disenchantment
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1..3 enchantment[s]. If an enchantment was lost in this way, that foe and all adjacent foes lose 10..100 Health.

skills.name: Mark of Fury
skills.title: Mark of Fury
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, allies hitting target foe gain 0..2 strike[s] of adrenaline. When this hex ends, that foe suffers from Cracked Armor for 1..15 second[s].

skills.name: Corrupt Enchantment
skills.title: Corrupt Enchantment
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. Remove one enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed in this way, that foe suffers from -1..8 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Signet of Sorrow
skills.title: Signet of Sorrow
skills.desc: Signet. Target foe takes 15..75 damage. If target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet, this skill recharges instantly.

skills.name: Signet of Suffering
skills.title: Signet of Suffering
skills.desc: Elite Signet. You suffer from Bleeding for 6 seconds. The next Necromancer skill that targets a foe causes Bleeding for 2..16 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: Even though it has no activation time, this signet (similar to Dolyak Signet) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an action.
ANOMALY: After being resurrected, if the player uses the skill in the middle of the stand up animation they will not begin bleeding.

skills.name: Signet of Lost Souls
skills.title: Signet of Lost Souls
skills.desc: Signet. If target foe is below 50% Health, you gain 10..100 Health and 1..10 Energy.

skills.name: Well of Darkness
skills.title: Well of Darkness
skills.desc: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Darkness for 5..50 seconds. Hexed foes within the Well of Darkness miss 50% of the time.

skills.name: Blinding Surge
skills.title: Blinding Surge
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 5..50 lightning damage. That foe and all adjacent foes are Blinded for 3..8 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If this spell strikes an attacking foe, all adjacent foes are also struck and this spell deals 50% more damage.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Sandstorm and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.

skills.name: Chilling Winds
skills.title: Chilling Winds
skills.desc: Hex Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30..60 cold damage. For 10 seconds, the next Water Magic hex targeting a hexed foe lasts 25..100% longer.
notes: BUG: Both descriptions fail to mention that the target and all adjacent foes also become hexed with Chilling Winds in addition to being struck with cold damage.

skills.name: Lightning Bolt
skills.title: Lightning Bolt
skills.desc: Spell. Send out a Lightning Bolt that strikes for 5..50 lightning damage if it hits. If Lightning Bolt strikes a moving foe, that foe is struck for 5..50 additional lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
notes: BUG: "Master of My Domain" considers each packet a separate skill.

skills.name: Storm Djinn's Haste
skills.title: Storm Djinn's Haste
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 10..25 seconds, you move 25% faster. Each second that you are moving, you lose 1 Energy.

skills.name: Stone Striker
skills.title: Stone Striker
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..30 seconds, whenever you take or deal elemental or physical damage, that damage is converted to earth damage.
notes: ANOMALY: This also converts chaos, dark, holy and spirit attacks damage types into earth damage.

BUG: This skill does not convert damage but instead forces the damage type of all dealt damage to be earth damage. For example when applying Winter on top of stone striker, physical damage is not converted into earth damage, since winter has no effect on it - it still considers the damage to be of physical type. This is irrespective of which damage converting skill is used first.

skills.name: Sandstorm
skills.title: Sandstorm
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Create a Sandstorm at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, nearby foes are struck for 20..40 earth damage each second and attacking foes are struck for an additional 10..30 earth damage each second.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Blinding Surge and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.

skills.name: Stone Sheath
skills.title: Stone Sheath
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5..20 seconds, you and target ally have +1..30 armor and are immune to critical hits. When you cast this spell, all foes near you and your target take 15..70 earth damage and are Weakened for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Ebon Hawk
skills.title: Ebon Hawk
skills.desc: Spell. Send a projectile that strikes target foe for 10..85 earth damage and causes Weakness for 5..15 seconds if it hits.

skills.name: Stoneflesh Aura
skills.title: Stoneflesh Aura
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..15 seconds, damage you receive is reduced by 1..31, and you are immune to critical attacks.
notes: BUG: This enchantment does not actually make you immune to critical hits, but prevents extra damage from them. As such, effects that may result from them, such as knock down, or the re-applying effect of Critical Agility and Critical Defenses will still apply. However, the damage-nullified critical hit will not trigger the energy gain of Critical Strikes.

skills.name: Glyph of Restoration
skills.title: Glyph of Restoration
skills.desc: Glyph. For 15 seconds, your next 2 spells heal you for 30..105 Health, and you are healed for 150..400% of the Energy cost of each spell.

skills.name: Ether Prism
skills.title: Ether Prism
skills.desc: Elite Skill. For 3 seconds, all damage you take is reduced by 75%. When Ether Prism ends, you gain 5..20 Energy.

skills.name: Master of Magic
skills.title: Master of Magic
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 1..61 second[s], all of your elemental attributes are set to 8..14 and your elemental spells return 1 Energy plus 30% of their Energy cost.
notes: BUG: While under the effects of Master of Magic, being weakened with attribute points in elemental ranks will cause elemental ranks to lower by 1. Elemental attributes without attribute points in will not lower by 1.

skills.name: Glowing Gaze
skills.title: Glowing Gaze
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe takes 5..50 fire damage. If that foe is on Fire, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.

skills.name: Flame Djinn's Haste
skills.title: Flame Djinn's Haste
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. All adjacent foes are struck for 15..120 fire damage. For 8..14 seconds, you move 25% faster. Flame Djinn's Haste recharges 50% faster if a foe was struck by this spell.

skills.name: Freezing Gust
skills.title: Freezing Gust
skills.desc: Hex Spell. If target foe is under the effect of a Water Magic hex, that foe is struck for 20..80 cold damage. Otherwise, that foe moves 66% slower for 1..5 second[s].

skills.name: Judge's Intervention
skills.title: Judge's Intervention
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, the next time target ally receives damage that would be fatal, the damage is negated and one nearby foe takes 30..180 holy damage.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike most other monk spells, Judge's Intervention does not invoke an animation upon the target.

skills.name: Supportive Spirit
skills.title: Supportive Spirit
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..23 seconds, whenever target ally takes damage while knocked down, that ally is healed for 5..50 Health.

skills.name: Watchful Healing
skills.title: Watchful Healing
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target ally gains +1..4 Health regeneration. If this skill ends prematurely, that ally gains 30..120 Health.

skills.name: Healer's Boon
skills.title: Healer's Boon
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10..55 seconds. Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster and heal for 50% more Health.

skills.name: Healer's Covenant
skills.title: Healer's Covenant
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, your Healing Prayers spells heal for 20% less Health, but cost -1..4 Energy.

skills.name: Balthazar's Pendulum
skills.title: Balthazar's Pendulum
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5..25 seconds, the next time target ally would be knocked down by a foe, that foe is knocked down instead.
notes: BUG: Doesn't work against Psychic Instability or Tremor.

skills.name: Words of Comfort
skills.title: Words of Comfort
skills.desc: Spell. Target ally is healed for 20..65 Health and an additional 20..50 Health if that ally is suffering from a condition.

skills.name: Scourge Enchantment
skills.title: Scourge Enchantment
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, each time target foe is the target of an enchantment, the caster of that enchantment takes 15..75 damage.

skills.name: Shield of Absorption
skills.title: Shield of Absorption
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 3..7 seconds, damage received by target ally is reduced by 5 each time that ally is hit while under the effects of this enchantment.

skills.name: Reversal of Damage
skills.title: Reversal of Damage
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally would take damage, the foe dealing the damage takes that damage instead (maximum 5..75).

skills.name: Mending Touch
skills.title: Mending Touch
skills.desc: Spell. Touched ally loses two conditions and is healed for 15..60 Health for each condition removed in this way.

skills.name: Critical Chop
skills.title: Critical Chop
skills.desc: Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you inflict +5..20 damage. If this attack results in a critical hit, target foe is interrupted.

skills.name: Agonizing Chop
skills.title: Agonizing Chop
skills.desc: Axe Attack. When this attack hits, you deal +5..20 damage. If target foe is suffering from a Deep Wound, you interrupt that foe's action.

skills.name: Headbutt
skills.title: Headbutt
skills.desc: Elite Skill. Target touched foe takes 40..100 damage. You are Dazed for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Lion's Comfort
skills.title: Lion's Comfort
skills.desc: Skill. All of your signets are disabled for 12 seconds. You are healed for 50..110 Health, and gain 0..3 strike[s] of adrenaline.

skills.name: Rage of the Ntouka
skills.title: Rage of the Ntouka
skills.desc: Elite Skill. Gain 1..7 strike[s] of adrenaline. For 8 seconds, whenever you use an adrenal skill, that skill recharges for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Mokele Smash
skills.title: Mokele Smash
skills.desc: Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +5..20 damage and gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.

skills.name: Overbearing Smash
skills.title: Overbearing Smash
skills.desc: Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +1..20 damage. If target foe is knocked down, that foe is Dazed for 1..8 second[s].

skills.name: Signet of Stamina
skills.title: Signet of Stamina
skills.desc: Signet. You have +50..300 maximum Health. This signet ends if you successfully hit with an attack.

skills.name: "You're All Alone!"
skills.title: "You're All Alone!"
skills.desc: Elite Shout. If target foe isn't near an ally, that foe suffers from Cripple and Weakness for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Burst of Aggression
skills.title: Burst of Aggression
skills.desc: Stance. For 2..10 seconds, you attack 33% faster. When this stance ends, you lose all adrenaline.

skills.name: Enraging Charge
skills.title: Enraging Charge
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..15 seconds, you move 25% faster. Enraging Charge ends when you successfully strike a target, at which point you gain 0..3 strike[s] of adrenaline if you hit with a melee attack.

skills.name: Crippling Slash
skills.title: Crippling Slash
skills.desc: Elite Sword Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Crippled for 5..15 seconds and begins Bleeding for 10..25 seconds.

skills.name: Barbarous Slice
skills.title: Barbarous Slice
skills.desc: Sword Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5..30 damage. If you are currently not in a stance, you also inflict Bleeding for 5..15 seconds.

skills.name: Prepared Shot
skills.title: Prepared Shot
skills.desc: Elite Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10..25 damage. If you are under the effects of a preparation, you gain 1..9 Energy.

skills.name: Burning Arrow
skills.title: Burning Arrow
skills.desc: Elite Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10..30 damage and cause Burning for 2..8 seconds.

skills.name: Arcing Shot
skills.title: Arcing Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. If this arrow hits, it strikes for +10..35 damage. This arrow cannot be blocked, but it moves 50% slower.

skills.name: Strike as One
skills.title: Strike as One
skills.desc: Elite Shout. Your animal companion instantly moves to your target and causes Bleeding for 5..15 seconds with its next attack. The next time you hit with an attack, target foe is Crippled for 5..15 seconds.
notes: BUG: Targeting yourself or an ally will sometimes cause your pet to stop moving. It will unfreeze when an opponent enters your aggro bubble or attacks it. This is exploited to perform the portal jumping technique known as a SaO chain.
ANOMALY: Strike as One's description omits the fact that it has a limited duration of 30 seconds.
ANOMALY: The French description of the skill mention an "enemy target" for the shadow step despite the fact that the skill can target either foe or friend

skills.name: Crossfire
skills.title: Crossfire
skills.desc: Bow Attack. If this attack hits target foe, it deals +5..20 damage. If that foe is near any of your allies, this attack cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Barbed Arrows
skills.title: Barbed Arrows
skills.desc: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your arrows cause Bleeding for 3..15 seconds. You have -40 armor while activating this skill.
notes: ANOMALY: The armor penalty from this skill is applied after the armor cap and the effects of Cracked Armor and armor penetration.

skills.name: Scavenger's Focus
skills.title: Scavenger's Focus
skills.desc: Elite Skill. For 10 seconds if you strike a foe who is suffering from a condition you gain 3..12 Energy.

skills.name: Toxicity
skills.title: Toxicity
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. Poisoned or Diseased creatures within its range suffer -2 Health degeneration. This spirit dies after 30..180 seconds.

skills.name: Quicksand
skills.title: Quicksand
skills.desc: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. All non-spirit creatures within its range lose 1 Energy each time they attack or use a skill. This spirit dies after 30..180 seconds.

skills.name: Storm's Embrace
skills.title: Storm's Embrace
skills.desc: Stance. For 10 seconds, you move 25% faster. This stance is refreshed whenever you take Elemental damage.

skills.name: Trapper's Speed
skills.title: Trapper's Speed
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..30 seconds, your Traps recharge 25% faster and activate 25% faster. This Stance ends if you successfully hit with an attack.

skills.name: Tripwire
skills.title: Tripwire
skills.desc: Trap. When Tripwire is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5..20 piercing damage. Any Crippled foes are knocked down. Tripwire ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

skills.name: Renewing Surge
skills.title: Renewing Surge
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 8 seconds, target foe suffers 2..12 damage each second. When this hex ends, you gain 1..8 Energy.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike other hexes that affect the caster, this hex does not end if the caster dies.

skills.name: Offering of Spirit
skills.title: Offering of Spirit
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Gain 8..17 Energy. If any spirits are within earshot, you do not sacrifice Health.

skills.name: Spirit's Gift
skills.title: Spirit's Gift
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, all allies near that creature gain 5..50 Health and lose 1 condition.

skills.name: Reclaim Essence
skills.title: Reclaim Essence
skills.desc: Elite Spell. All of your Spirits die. You gain 5..20 Energy and all of your Binding Rituals are recharged if a Spirit died in this way.

skills.name: Mystic Sweep
skills.title: Mystic Sweep
skills.desc: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +3..12 damage. If you are enchanted, this attack deals an additional +3..12 damage.

skills.name: Eremite's Attack
skills.title: Eremite's Attack
skills.desc: Scythe Attack. If it hits, this attack deals +1..10 damage and removes a Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, you do an additional +1..10 damage and strike all adjacent foes.
notes: BUG: The full description is incorrect: a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.

skills.name: Reap Impurities
skills.title: Reap Impurities
skills.desc: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +3..15 damage. Each foe you hit loses 1 condition. For each foe who loses a condition, all foes adjacent to that target foe take 10..40 holy damage.
notes: BUG: The holy damage is dealt to other foes adjacent to yourself, not adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Victorious Sweep
skills.title: Victorious Sweep
skills.desc: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5..25 damage. If target foe has less Health than you, you gain 30..80 Health.

skills.name: Mystic Twister
skills.title: Mystic Twister
skills.desc: Spell. Deals 10..60 cold damage to all nearby foes. If you are enchanted, this spell deals an additional 10..60 cold damage.

skills.name: Grenth's Fingers
skills.title: Grenth's Fingers
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 10..40 cold damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal cold damage. When this enchantment ends, you transfer  1..2 condition[s] to all nearby foes.

skills.name: Balthazar's Rage
skills.title: Balthazar's Rage
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes are set on fire for 1..3 second[s]. For 20 seconds afterward, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, you gain 1..2 strike[s] of adrenaline if any foes are within earshot.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to other skills with an end effect, the end effect of Balthazar's Rage will trigger upon death. When a character who died while enchanted with Balthazar's Rage is resurrected, the adrenaline gained from this skill's end effect will still be active on the character, instead of having no adrenaline when resurrected.

skills.name: Staggering Force
skills.title: Staggering Force
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 10..40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes have Cracked Armor for 1..10 second[s].

skills.name: Pious Renewal
skills.title: Pious Renewal
skills.desc: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, nothing happens. When this enchantment ends, Pious Renewal is recharged and you gain 0..5 Energy and 0..30 Health.

skills.name: Arcane Zeal
skills.title: Arcane Zeal
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever you cast a spell, you gain 2 Energy for each enchantment on you (maximum 2..7 Energy).
notes: BUG: This skill currently only grants 1 energy per enchantment

skills.name: Mystic Vigor
skills.title: Mystic Vigor
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, every time you successfully hit with an attack, you gain 3..15 Health for each enchantment on you (maximum 25 Health).

skills.name: Watchful Intervention
skills.title: Watchful Intervention
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, the next time damage drops target ally's Health below 25%, that ally is healed for 50..200 Health.

skills.name: Vow of Piety
skills.title: Vow of Piety
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have +24 armor and +1..4 Health regeneration. Vow of Piety renews whenever an enchantment on you ends.
notes: ANOMALY: When a character is enchanted with Vow of Piety and at least one Air Magic, Earth Magic, Fire Magic or Water Magic enchantment (e.g. Windborne Speed), and loses all enchantments (e.g. due to the effects of Gaze of Contempt, Release Enchantments or Second Wind, but not Rend Enchantments nor Strip Enchantment that remove a certain number of enchantments), Vow of Piety will still be reapplied. This does not occur for Energy Storage, dervish nor monk enchantments. {[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LnzpNuYMpxc&list=PLWqdCE9awrzQgi9axfgeRHlYI7v8zIduS Video]}.

skills.name: Vital Boon
skills.title: Vital Boon
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have +40..100 maximum Health. When this enchantment ends, you are healed for 75..200 Health.
notes: BUG: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes health gain and not healing.

skills.name: Heart of Holy Flame
skills.title: Heart of Holy Flame
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes take 5..30 holy damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are set on fire for 2..5 seconds.

skills.name: Extend Enchantments
skills.title: Extend Enchantments
skills.desc: Skill. For 10 seconds, your next Dervish enchantment lasts 10..150% longer.
notes: BUG: The visual indicator of the maximum duration on the skill icon of Vow of Piety and Vow of Revolution in the skill monitor is not full after renewal if they were extended before.

skills.name: Faithful Intervention
skills.title: Faithful Intervention
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. If damage drops your Health below 50%, Faithful Intervention ends. When Faithful Intervention ends, you are healed for 30..150 Health.
notes: BUG: Contrary to the concise description, this skill causes healing and not health gain. It also fails to mention that the healing is an end effect.

skills.name: Sand Shards
skills.title: Sand Shards
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, the next 1..5 time[s] you hit with a scythe, all other adjacent foes take 10..60 earth damage.

skills.name: Armor of Sanctity
skills.title: Armor of Sanctity
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. All adjacent foes suffer from Weakness for 5..15 seconds. For 15 seconds, you take 5..20 less damage from foes suffering from a condition.

skills.name: Vow of Silence
skills.title: Vow of Silence
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5..10 seconds, you cannot be the target of spells, and you cannot cast spells.

skills.name: Avatar of Balthazar
skills.title: Avatar of Balthazar
skills.desc: Elite Form. For 10..90 seconds, you gain +20 armor against physical damage, you gain adrenaline 25% faster, your attacks deal holy damage, and whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, nearby foes are set on fire for 1..3 second[s]. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

skills.name: Avatar of Grenth
skills.title: Avatar of Grenth
skills.desc: Elite Form. For 10..90 seconds, your scythe attacks deal dark damage, and steal 0..12 Health. You are immune to Disease, and inflict Disease on all adjacent foes for 3 seconds whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

skills.name: Avatar of Lyssa
skills.title: Avatar of Lyssa
skills.desc: Elite Form. For 10..90 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 50% faster and your attacks deal chaos damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, steal 1 Energy from all nearby foes. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

skills.name: Meditation
skills.title: Meditation
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. Lose all adrenaline. For 20 seconds, you gain 1..4 Energy every time an enchantment on you ends.

skills.name: Eremite's Zeal
skills.title: Eremite's Zeal
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. You gain 1..3 Energy for each foe within earshot, maximum 8 Energy. For 10 seconds afterward, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, you gain 1..3 Energy for each foe within earshot, maximum 8 Energy.
notes: BUG: Heroes don't use this skill unless enchanted.

skills.name: Natural Healing
skills.title: Natural Healing
skills.desc: Spell. You are healed for 50..170 Health. If you are not enchanted, this spell activates 50% faster.

skills.name: Imbue Health
skills.title: Imbue Health
skills.desc: Spell. Target other ally is healed for 5..50% of your current Health (maximum 300 Health).

skills.name: Dwayna's Touch
skills.title: Dwayna's Touch
skills.desc: Spell. Target touched ally is healed for 60 Health for each Enchantment on you (maximum 60..240).

skills.name: Signet of Pious Light
skills.title: Signet of Pious Light
skills.desc: Signet. Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Target ally is healed for 30..150 Health. If an enchantment was removed in this way, this signet recharges 75% faster.
notes: ANOMALY: As long as the user is under the effects of a Dervish enchantment when attempting to activate this skill, Signet of Pious Light will recharge in 5 seconds, regardless of other effects.

skills.name: Intimidating Aura
skills.title: Intimidating Aura
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, you have +40..100 max Health and take 1..10 less damage from foes with less Health than you.

skills.name: Mystic Sandstorm
skills.title: Mystic Sandstorm
skills.desc: Spell. Create a sandstorm at your location that lasts 3 seconds. Each second, foes nearby this location take 10..40 earth damage. Attacking foes take an additional 10..20 damage. If you are enchanted when you cast this spell, it lasts twice as long.

skills.name: Winds of Disenchantment
skills.title: Winds of Disenchantment
skills.desc: Spell. Lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If a Dervish enchantment was removed in this way, all nearby foes lose 1 enchantment and take 20..80 cold damage.

skills.name: Rending Touch
skills.title: Rending Touch
skills.desc: Spell. Deals 15..65 cold damage to target foe. You lose one Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, target foe loses 1 enchantment and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
notes: ANOMALY: The cold damage dealt by this skill is armor-ignoring.
BUG: The full description fails to mention that this spell has a touch range (the concise description is correct).

skills.name: Crippling Sweep
skills.title: Crippling Sweep
skills.desc: Scythe Attack. If this attack hits a foe, that foe is Crippled for 3..12 seconds. This skill deals +3..15 extra damage if that foe is moving.

skills.name: Wearying Strike
skills.title: Wearying Strike
skills.desc: Scythe Attack. You remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, you inflict a Deep Wound for 3..10 seconds. You suffer from Weakness for 10 seconds if an enchantment is not removed.

skills.name: Lyssa's Assault
skills.title: Lyssa's Assault
skills.desc: Scythe Attack. This attack interrupts an action if it hits. If you are enchanted, any skill you interrupt is disabled for additional 1..10 second[s]. This attack does 50% normal damage.

skills.name: Chilling Victory
skills.title: Chilling Victory
skills.desc: Scythe Attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +3..15 damage. For each foe hit who has less Health than you, that foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 10..30 cold damage.

skills.name: Conviction
skills.title: Conviction
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, you gain +10 armor if you have a condition and gain 1..3 Health regen for each condition you are suffering from. When this enchantment ends, you are cured of 1..2 condition[s].

skills.name: Enchanted Haste
skills.title: Enchanted Haste
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 7 seconds, you move 25% faster. If this enchantment ends prematurely, you lose 1 condition.

skills.name: Pious Concentration
skills.title: Pious Concentration
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..20 seconds, you cannot be interrupted, but each time you would have been interrupted, you lose 1 Dervish enchantment or Pious Concentration ends.

skills.name: Pious Haste
skills.title: Pious Haste
skills.desc: Stance. You remove 1 Dervish enchantment and for 1..7 second[s] you move 25% faster. If an enchantment was removed you move 50% faster instead.
notes: BUG: If your Mysticism is at 0, the skill will still remove an enchantment but only give 25% move speed instead of 50%.

skills.name: Test of Faith
skills.title: Test of Faith
skills.desc: Spell. Deals 15..75 cold damage and takes 1 enchantment from target foe. If that foe was not enchanted, that foe is Dazed for 2..6 second[s].
notes: ANOMALY: The full description does not mention that this skill operates at touch-range.

skills.name: Blazing Spear
skills.title: Blazing Spear
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, it deals +5..25 damage and sets target foe on Fire for 1..3 second[s].

skills.name: Cruel Spear
skills.title: Cruel Spear
skills.desc: Elite Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10..50 damage. If it hits a non-moving target, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Unblockable Throw
skills.title: Unblockable Throw
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10..40 damage. This attack cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Spear of Lightning
skills.title: Spear of Lightning
skills.desc: Spear Attack. Strikes all foes between you and your target. If this attack hits, it deals +10..20 lightning damage. This attack has 25% armor penetration.

skills.name: Wearying Spear
skills.title: Wearying Spear
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10..40 damage. You are Weakened for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Anthem of Fury
skills.title: Anthem of Fury
skills.desc: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, all party members within earshot gain 2..5 strikes of adrenaline the next time they use an attack skill.

skills.name: Crippling Anthem
skills.title: Crippling Anthem
skills.desc: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot causes Crippling for 5..15 seconds.

skills.name: Godspeed
skills.title: Godspeed
skills.desc: Shout. For 5..20 seconds, all allies within earshot move 25% faster while under the effects of an enchantment.
notes: ANOMALY: This skill doesn't have punctuation in its name like other shouts, even though the character still shouts it with the punctuation.

skills.name: Anthem of Flame
skills.title: Anthem of Flame
skills.desc: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each party member within earshot also causes Burning for 1..5 second[s].
notes: BUG: In the case of an attack skill that hits several foes, such as Whirlwind Attack, only one will be inflicted with burning, and not necessarily the one targeted by the attack.

skills.name: Song of Power
skills.title: Song of Power
skills.desc: Chant. For 5..20 seconds, each ally within earshot gains 4 Energy regeneration until that ally uses a Skill.

skills.name: Zealous Anthem
skills.title: Zealous Anthem
skills.desc: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses an attack skill, that ally gains 1..8 Energy.

skills.name: Aria of Zeal
skills.title: Aria of Zeal
skills.desc: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a Spell, that ally gains 1..6 Energy.

skills.name: Lyric of Zeal
skills.title: Lyric of Zeal
skills.desc: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a signet, that ally gains 1..8 Energy.

skills.name: Chorus of Restoration
skills.title: Chorus of Restoration
skills.desc: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a shout or chant, that ally is healed for 30..90 Health.

skills.name: Aria of Restoration
skills.title: Aria of Restoration
skills.desc: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a spell, that party member gains 30..90 Health.

skills.name: Song of Concentration
skills.title: Song of Concentration
skills.desc: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next skill used by each ally within earshot cannot be interrupted.

skills.name: Anthem of Guidance
skills.title: Anthem of Guidance
skills.desc: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each party member within earshot cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Energizing Chorus
skills.title: Energizing Chorus
skills.desc: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next Shout or Chant used by each ally within earshot costs 3..7 less Energy.
notes: ANOMALY: Because this chant reduces cost at the beginning of skill activation and doesn't end until activation is completed, using a shout in the middle of a chant's activation will allow both skills to benefit from this chant.

skills.name: Song of Purification
skills.title: Song of Purification
skills.desc: Elite Chant. For 20 seconds, the next 1..6 skill[s] used by each ally within earshot remove 1 condition from that ally.
notes: BUG: Re-application does not reset the number of uses remaining until the original application would have ended. It appears to count any skill uses against both applications, and the chant will end if the number of uses remaining from the original application reaches 0.

skills.name: Hexbreaker Aria
skills.title: Hexbreaker Aria
skills.desc: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot casts a spell, that ally loses 1 hex.

skills.name: Awe
skills.title: Awe
skills.desc: Skill. If this skill hits a knocked-down foe, that foe becomes Dazed for 5..15 seconds.

skills.name: Enduring Harmony
skills.title: Enduring Harmony
skills.desc: Echo. For 10..35 seconds, chants and shouts last 50% longer on target non-spirit ally.

skills.name: Burning Refrain
skills.title: Burning Refrain
skills.desc: Echo. For 20 seconds, if target non-spirit ally hits a foe with more Health than that ally, that foe is set on Fire for 1..3 second[s]. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.

skills.name: Purifying Finale
skills.title: Purifying Finale
skills.desc: Echo. For 10..35 seconds, target non-spirit ally loses 1 condition whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally.

skills.name: Glowing Signet
skills.title: Glowing Signet
skills.desc: Signet. If target foe is Burning, you gain 5..15 Energy.

skills.name: Leader's Zeal
skills.title: Leader's Zeal
skills.desc: Skill. For each nearby ally, you gain 2..4 Energy (maximum 8..12 Energy).

skills.name: Leader's Comfort
skills.title: Leader's Comfort
skills.desc: Skill. You gain 30..75 Health. For each ally within earshot, you also gain +10..20 Health (maximum 140 Health).
notes: BUG: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.

skills.name: Signet of Synergy
skills.title: Signet of Synergy
skills.desc: Signet. Target other ally is healed for 40..100 Health. If you are not under the effects of an enchantment, you are also healed for 40..100 Health.

skills.name: Angelic Protection
skills.title: Angelic Protection
skills.desc: Skill. For 10 seconds, any time target other ally takes more than 250..80 damage per second, that ally is healed for any damage over that amount.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike most typeless skills with no activation time, this skill cannot be activated in the middle of another action and has a slight aftercast delay.

skills.name: Angelic Bond
skills.title: Angelic Bond
skills.desc: Elite Skill. For 10 seconds, the next time an ally within earshot would take fatal damage, that damage is negated and that ally is healed for 20..200 Health. Angelic Bond ends on all other allies.
notes: BUG: The skill states it will end on all other allies, however, it will only end on party members of the ally that it triggers on, not all allies.
ANOMALY: Despite the skill descriptions, this skill triggers with health degeneration, health loss, life stealing, and health sacrifice, not just damage.

skills.name: Cautery Signet
skills.title: Cautery Signet
skills.desc: Elite Signet. All party members lose all conditions. You are set on Fire for 1 second for each condition removed in this way.
notes: ANOMALY: Although the effect extends beyond party range, the AI only considers allies within the expected range.

skills.name: "Lead the Way!"
skills.title: "Lead the Way!"
skills.desc: Shout. Target ally moves 25% faster for 1..5 seconds for each ally within earshot (maximum of 30 seconds).

skills.name: "Make Haste!"
skills.title: "Make Haste!"
skills.desc: Shout. For 5..20 seconds, target other ally moves 33% faster. This skill ends if that ally successfully hits with an attack.

skills.name: "They're on Fire!"
skills.title: "They're on Fire!"
skills.desc: Shout. For 10 seconds, party members within earshot take 5..35% less damage from foes suffering from Burning.

skills.name: "It's Just a Flesh Wound."
skills.title: "It's Just a Flesh Wound."
skills.desc: Elite Shout. Target other ally loses all conditions. If a condition was removed in this way, that ally moves 25% faster for 1..10 second[s].
notes: ANOMALY: If a condition is removed, Leadership will restore energy as if it affected two targets, requiring minimum 8 Leadership to receive the doubled benefit. This causes it to have a net cost of 1 energy.

skills.name: Barbed Spear
skills.title: Barbed Spear
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Vicious Attack
skills.title: Vicious Attack
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5..20 damage. If you land a critical hit with this attack, target foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5..15 seconds.

skills.name: Stunning Strike
skills.title: Stunning Strike
skills.desc: Elite Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10..50 damage. If it hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is also Dazed for 4..10 seconds.

skills.name: Merciless Spear
skills.title: Merciless Spear
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits a foe with less than 50% Health, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Disrupting Throw
skills.title: Disrupting Throw
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is interrupted.

skills.name: Wild Throw
skills.title: Wild Throw
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, it deals +5..20 damage, and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked. All of your non-spear attack skills are disabled for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Malicious Strike
skills.title: Malicious Strike
skills.desc: Melee Attack. If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, you deal +10..30 damage and this attack results in a critical hit.

skills.name: Shattering Assault
skills.title: Shattering Assault
skills.desc: Elite Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, you deal 5..50 damage and target foe loses one enchantment. This attack cannot be blocked.
notes: BUG: This skill replaces your dagger's attack damage with the stated damage, which is non-armor-ignoring damage (unlike other attack skills such as Distracting Shot and Needling Shot). This damage is affected by Dagger Mastery, critical hits, armor penetration, inscription and inscription-equivalent weapon damage bonuses and the target's armor rating, but does not benefit from the customization damage bonus.

skills.name: Golden Skull Strike
skills.title: Golden Skull Strike
skills.desc: Elite Off-Hand Attack. If you are under the effects of an enchantment and this attack hits, target foe is Dazed 1..12 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: The concise description fails to mention that only daze will not have effect if not enchanted (the attack will not fail).

skills.name: Black Spider Strike
skills.title: Black Spider Strike
skills.desc: Off-Hand Attack. Must strike a hexed foe. If it hits, this attack strikes for +5..20 damage and target foe is Poisoned for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Golden Fox Strike
skills.title: Golden Fox Strike
skills.desc: Lead Attack. If this attack hits, target foe takes +10..30 damage. If you are under the effects of an Enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Deadly Haste
skills.title: Deadly Haste
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 10..35 seconds, half-ranged spells cast 5..50% faster and recharge 5..60% faster.

skills.name: Fox's Promise
skills.title: Fox's Promise
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5..20 seconds, your dagger attacks cannot be blocked. This enchantment ends the next time you fail to hit.

skills.name: Feigned Neutrality
skills.title: Feigned Neutrality
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 4..10 seconds, you have +7 Health regeneration and +80 armor. This enchantment ends if you successfully hit with an attack or use a skill.

skills.name: Hidden Caltrops
skills.title: Hidden Caltrops
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. Your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 3 seconds. For 1..10 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When this hex ends that foe is Crippled for 1..15 seconds.
notes: BUG: Crippling modifiers on weapons do not extend the duration of cripple caused by the end effect.

skills.name: Assault Enchantments
skills.title: Assault Enchantments
skills.desc: Elite Skill. Must follow a dual attack. Target foe loses all enchantments.

skills.name: Wastrel's Collapse
skills.title: Wastrel's Collapse
skills.desc: Elite Skill. Shadow Step to target foe. If target foe is not using a skill, that foe is knocked down. All of your non-dagger attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Lift Enchantment
skills.title: Lift Enchantment
skills.desc: Touch Skill. If target touched foe is knocked down, that foe loses one enchantment.

skills.name: Augury of Death
skills.title: Augury of Death
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5..35 seconds, the next time damage would drop target foe's Health below 50%, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5..20 seconds and Shadow Step to that foe. This spell has half the normal range.
notes: ANOMALY: Similar to Life Siphon and enchantments with upkeep, if a hexed foe moves out of compass range of the caster, Augury of Death will end.

skills.name: Signet of Toxic Shock
skills.title: Signet of Toxic Shock
skills.desc: Signet. If target foe is suffering from Poison, that foe takes 10..100 damage.

skills.name: Signet of Twilight
skills.title: Signet of Twilight
skills.desc: Signet. For each hex on target foe, that foe loses one enchantment.

skills.name: Way of the Assassin
skills.title: Way of the Assassin
skills.desc: Elite Stance. For the next 20 seconds while wielding daggers, you attack 5..20% faster and have a +5..35% chance to land a critical hit.

skills.name: Shadow Walk
skills.title: Shadow Walk
skills.desc: Stance. Shadow Step to target foe. For 15 seconds nothing happens. Your attack skills are disabled for 1 second, and your stances and enchantments are disabled for 10 seconds. When this stance ends, you return to your original location.

skills.name: Death's Retreat
skills.title: Death's Retreat
skills.desc: Spell. Shadow Step to target ally. If you have less Health than that ally, you gain 40..130 Health.
notes: ANOMALY: Death's Retreat is one of the few spells that do not suffer from aftercast delay.

skills.name: Shadow Prison
skills.title: Shadow Prison
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. For 1..7 seconds, that foe moves 66% slower.

skills.name: Swap
skills.title: Swap
skills.desc: Spell. You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's location.
notes: ANOMALY: This spell does not have an aftercast delay.

skills.name: Shadow Meld
skills.title: Shadow Meld
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. Shadow Step to target other ally. When you stop maintaining this Enchantment, you return to your original location.
notes: ANOMALY: This spell does not have an aftercast delay.

skills.name: Price of Pride
skills.title: Price of Pride
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5 seconds, the next time target foe uses an elite skill, that foe loses 3..15 Energy.
notes: BUG: Second Wind does not trigger this skill.

skills.name: Air of Disenchantment
skills.title: Air of Disenchantment
skills.desc: Elite Hex Spell. Remove one enchantment from target foe and all nearby foes. For 5..20 seconds, enchantments expire 150..300% faster on those foes.
notes: ANOMALY: If an enchantment duration is reduced below 1 second, it behaves as if it was not applied.
BUG: Although the description says "150..300% faster", the actual behavior is "at 150..300% the normal rate", which is only 50..200% faster.

skills.name: Symbolic Posture
skills.title: Symbolic Posture

skills.desc: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 15..75 cold damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, that foe becomes Poisoned for 10..25 seconds.

skills.name: Well of Silence

skills.desc: Well Spell. Exploit target corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Silence for 10..30 seconds. Foes within the well cannot use shouts or chants and suffer -1..4 Health degeneration.

notes: ANOMALY: Invoke Lightning's animation shows strikes on all possible targets, not just the three that are actually hit.

skills.name: Pensive Guardian

skills.name: Scribe's Insight

skills.name: Glimmer of Light

skills.title: Signet of Mystic Wrath

skills.name: Signet of Removal

skills.name: Dismiss Condition
skills.title: Dismiss Condition
skills.desc: Spell. Remove one condition from target ally. If that ally is under the effects of an enchantment, that ally is healed for 15..75 Health.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike most other skills with a healing component, Dismiss Condition can target spirits.

skills.name: Divert Hexes
skills.title: Divert Hexes
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Remove up to 1..3 hex[es] from target ally. For each hex removed in this way, that ally loses one condition and gains 15..75 Health.

skills.name: Counterattack

skills.desc: Elite Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +7..25 damage. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
notes: BUG: Against unenchanted targets this skill causes block bypassing effects such as Asuran Scan or Warrior's Cunning to be ignored.

skills.name: Soldier's Strike
skills.title: Soldier's Strike
skills.desc: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10..40 more damage. If you are under the effects of a chant or shout, this attack cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Decapitate

skills.desc: Elite Axe Attack. You lose all adrenaline and all Energy. This attack is unblockable, you deal +5..80 damage and cause a Deep Wound for 5..20 seconds. This attack is always critical and if foe is killed, nearby foes are Weakened for 8 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: The concise description fails to mention that the attack is unblockable

skills.name: Magehunter's Smash

skills.desc: Elite Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is knocked down. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.

notes: ANOMALY: Adrenaline will be gained even for attacks blocked by another blocking source (regardless of whether the user is under the effects of a shout or chant).

skills.name: Frenzied Defense
skills.title: Frenzied Defense
skills.desc: Stance. For 8 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks, but take double damage.

skills.name: Steady Stance

skills.desc: Elite Stance. For 10 seconds, the next time you would be knocked down, you gain 1..4 strike[s] of adrenaline and 1..7 Energy instead.

skills.name: Steelfang Slash
skills.title: Steelfang Slash
skills.desc: Sword Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +1..31 damage. If you hit a foe that is knocked down, you gain 1..5 adrenaline.

skills.name: Screaming Shot
skills.title: Screaming Shot
skills.desc: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10..25 damage. If your target is within earshot, that foe begins Bleeding for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Rampage as One
skills.title: Rampage as One
skills.desc: Elite Skill. For 3..15 seconds, both you and your animal companion attack 33% faster and run 25% faster.
notes: BUG: The full description omits that this skill needs your pet to be alive to activate.

skills.name: Forked Arrow

skills.desc: Bow Attack. Shoot two arrows simultaneously at target foe. If you are under the effects of an enchantment or hex, you shoot only one arrow.

skills.name: Disrupting Accuracy
skills.title: Disrupting Accuracy
skills.desc: Preparation. For 36 seconds, whenever your arrows critical, they also interrupt your target.

skills.name: Roaring Winds
skills.title: Roaring Winds
skills.desc: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1..10 spirit. Chants and shouts cost 1..5 more Energy. This spirit dies after 30..180 seconds.

skills.name: Magebane Shot
skills.title: Magebane Shot
skills.desc: Elite Bow Attack. If this attack hits, it interrupts target foe's action. If that action was a spell, it is disabled for an additional 10 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Natural Stride
skills.title: Natural Stride
skills.desc: Stance. For 1..8 second[s], you run 33% faster and have a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. Natural Stride ends if you become hexed or enchanted.

skills.name: Heket's Rampage
skills.title: Heket's Rampage
skills.desc: Stance. For 5..11 seconds, you attack 33% faster. This stance ends if you use an attack skill.

skills.name: Smoke Trap
skills.title: Smoke Trap
skills.desc: Elite Trap. When Smoke Trap is triggered, nearby foes are Blinded and Dazed for 5..10 seconds. Smoke Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

skills.name: Vocal Was Sogolon
skills.title: Vocal Was Sogolon
skills.desc: Item Spell. For 60 seconds, all shouts and chants you use last 20..50% longer.

skills.name: Wielder's Strike
skills.title: Wielder's Strike
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe is struck for 10..60 lightning damage. If you are under the effects of a weapon spell, you deal an additional 10..50 lightning damage.

skills.name: Spirit's Strength
skills.title: Spirit's Strength
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15..60 seconds, your attacks deal 5..35 more damage while under the effects of a weapon spell.

skills.name: Wielder's Zeal
skills.title: Wielder's Zeal
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10..40 seconds, whenever you cast a Weapon Spell on an ally, you gain 1..5 Energy.

skills.name: Sight Beyond Sight
skills.title: Sight Beyond Sight
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 8..20 seconds, you cannot be Blinded.

skills.name: Renewing Memories
skills.title: Renewing Memories
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..20 seconds, while holding an item, any weapon and item Spells you cast cost 5..35% less Energy.

skills.name: Wielder's Remedy
skills.title: Wielder's Remedy
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 10..30 seconds, whenever you cast a weapon spell on an ally, that ally loses 2 conditions.

skills.name: Ghostmirror Light
skills.title: Ghostmirror Light
skills.desc: Spell. Target other ally is healed for 15..90 Health. If you are within earshot of a spirit, you are also healed for 15..90 Health.
notes: ANOMALY: While most healing spells can't target a spirit, this one can. Though the spirit receives no healing from it, the user does.
BUG: Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes healing and not health gain.

skills.name: Signet of Binding
skills.title: Signet of Binding
skills.desc: Signet. You lose 200..50 Health and take control of target enemy-controlled spirit. (50% failure chance with Spawning Power 4 or less.)
notes: ANOMALY: Spirits taken control of with this skill ignore the restriction of having multiple allied spirits of the same name within range of each other. The restriction will however be correctly applied should the spirit be teleported via Draw Spirit, Swap or Summon Spirits, preserving only the most recent spirit.

skills.name: Caretaker's Charge
skills.title: Caretaker's Charge
skills.desc: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 20..85 lightning damage. If you are holding an item, you gain 7 Energy and 5..50 Health.

skills.name: Weapon of Fury
skills.title: Weapon of Fury
skills.desc: Elite Weapon Spell. For 5..20 seconds, target ally gains 100% more adrenaline and 1 Energy whenever that ally successfully hits with an attack.

skills.name: Xinrae's Weapon
skills.title: Xinrae's Weapon
skills.desc: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage from a foe that damage is limited to 5% of that ally's max Health and that ally steals up to 20..80 Health from that foe.

skills.name: Warmonger's Weapon
skills.title: Warmonger's Weapon
skills.desc: Weapon Spell. For 3..13 seconds, if target ally attacks a foe who is not attacking, that foe is interrupted.

skills.name: Weapon of Remedy
skills.title: Weapon of Remedy
skills.desc: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, that ally steals up to 20..80 Health from that foe and loses 2 conditions.
notes: BUG: If used when taking damage from multiple sources from only one attack, Weapon of Remedy will trigger multiple times. For example, if a foe hexed with Barbs takes physical damage, Weapon of Remedy will trigger both for the physical damage and for the Barbs damage.

skills.name: Rending Sweep
skills.title: Rending Sweep
skills.desc: Scythe Attack. You deal +5..20 and lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was lost, you remove an enchantment from each foe you hit.

skills.name: Grenth's Grasp
skills.title: Grenth's Grasp
skills.desc: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, your attack skills also Cripple that foe for 1..11 second[s] and you transfer 1..3 condition[s] from yourself to that foe.

skills.name: Veil of Thorns
skills.title: Veil of Thorns
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are struck for 5..50 piercing damage. For 5..25 seconds you take 5..35% less damage from spells.

skills.name: Vow of Strength
skills.title: Vow of Strength
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack a foe with your scythe, you deal 10..25 slashing damage to all adjacent foes.

skills.name: Ebon Dust Aura
skills.title: Ebon Dust Aura
skills.desc: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are Blinded for 1..7 second[s]. For 30 seconds, if you are wielding an earth weapon, your melee attacks deal +3..30 earth damage. When this enchantment ends, you are cured of Blindness.

skills.name: Zealous Vow
skills.title: Zealous Vow
skills.desc: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have -2 Energy regeneration, and you gain 1..6 Energy every time you hit with an attack.

skills.name: Zealous Renewal
skills.title: Zealous Renewal
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes take 5..30 holy damage. For 5..25 seconds, you have -1 Energy regeneration, and gain 1 Energy whenever you hit a foe. If this enchantment ends prematurely, you gain 1..5 Energy.

skills.name: Attacker's Insight
skills.title: Attacker's Insight
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 3..10 seconds you have a 50% chance to block while attacking. When this enchantment ends, you inflict Weakness on all adjacent foes for 3..15 seconds.

skills.name: Rending Aura
skills.title: Rending Aura
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes take 10..40 cold damage. For  30 seconds, your attack skills remove enchantments from knocked-down foes. When this enchantment ends, nearby foes are affected by Cracked Armor for 1..10 second[s].

skills.name: Featherfoot Grace
skills.title: Featherfoot Grace
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..20 seconds, you move 25% faster, and conditions expire 50% faster.

skills.name: Reaper's Sweep
skills.title: Reaper's Sweep
skills.desc: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you Cripple your target for 3..15 seconds. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, this attack knocks down for 2..3 seconds.

skills.name: Harrier's Haste
skills.title: Harrier's Haste
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 2..8 seconds, you move 25% faster and deal +3..12 more damage against moving foes.

skills.name: Focused Anger
skills.title: Focused Anger
skills.desc: Elite Skill. For 45 seconds, you gain 0..150% more adrenaline.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike most skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain by a multiplier, this increases all non-multiplier sources of adrenaline, not just the basic 1 strike from making an attack.

skills.name: Natural Temper
skills.title: Natural Temper
skills.desc: Skill. For 4..15 seconds, you gain 33% more adrenaline while not under the effects of an Enchantment.

skills.name: Lyric of Purification
skills.title: Lyric of Purification
skills.desc: Chant. For 5..20 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a Signet, that ally loses 1 Condition.

skills.name: Soldier's Fury
skills.title: Soldier's Fury
skills.desc: Elite Echo. For 10..35 seconds, if you are under the effects of a chant or a shout, you attack 33% faster and gain 33% more adrenaline, but you have -20 armor.
notes: BUG: Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
BUG: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that grant +46 or more armor rating, Soldier's Fury's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.

skills.name: Aggressive Refrain
skills.title: Aggressive Refrain
skills.desc: Echo. For 5..25 seconds, you attack 25% faster but have -20 armor. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on you.
notes: BUG: Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
BUG: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that grant +46 or more armor rating, Aggressive Refrain's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.

skills.name: Energizing Finale
skills.title: Energizing Finale
skills.desc: Echo. For 10..35 seconds, whenever a shout or chant ends on target non-spirit ally, that ally gains 1..2 Energy.

skills.name: Signet of Aggression
skills.title: Signet of Aggression
skills.desc: Signet. If you are under the effects of a shout or chant, you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.

skills.name: Remedy Signet
skills.title: Remedy Signet
skills.desc: Signet. You lose 1 condition.

skills.name: "Make Your Time!"
skills.title: "Make Your Time!"
skills.desc: Shout. You gain 2 strikes of adrenaline for each party member within earshot (maximum 1..8 adrenaline).
notes: ANOMALY: This skill does not trigger any energy gain from Leadership, even for affecting the skill user.
BUG: "Make Your Time!" counts all allies, not just party members.

skills.name: "The Power Is Yours!"
skills.title: "The Power Is Yours!"
skills.desc: Elite Shout. For 2..4 seconds, all allies within earshot gain 1..2 Energy regeneration.

skills.name: Slayer's Spear
skills.title: Slayer's Spear
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5..25 damage. If that foe has more Health than you, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Swift Javelin
skills.title: Swift Javelin
skills.desc: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5..20 damage. If you are under the effects of an enchantment, this spear flies twice as fast and cannot be blocked.

skills.name: Vampiric Assault
skills.title: Vampiric Assault
skills.desc: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If this attack hits, you steal 10..40 Health.

skills.name: Lotus Strike
skills.title: Lotus Strike
skills.desc: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10..25 damage and you gain 5..20 Energy.

skills.name: Golden Fang Strike
skills.title: Golden Fang Strike
skills.desc: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. If you are under the effects of an enchantment and this attack hits, target foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Falling Lotus Strike
skills.title: Falling Lotus Strike
skills.desc: Off-Hand Attack. Must strike a knocked-down foe. If it hits, you strike for +15..35 damage and gain 1..12 Energy.

skills.name: Sadist's Signet
skills.title: Sadist's Signet
skills.desc: Signet. You gain 10..45 Health for each condition on target foe.

skills.name: Signet of Distraction
skills.title: Signet of Distraction
skills.desc: Signet. If target foe is casting a spell, that spell is interrupted and disabled for 1..5 seconds for each signet you have equipped.
notes: BUG: Contrary to the concise description, the interrupt does not need to succeed for the spell to become disabled.

skills.name: Signet of Recall
skills.title: Signet of Recall
skills.desc: Signet. For 6 seconds, you have -4 Energy regeneration. When this effect ends, you gain 13..20 Energy.

skills.name: Power Lock
skills.title: Power Lock
skills.desc: Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill is interrupted and disabled for an additional 5..13 seconds.

skills.name: Waste Not, Want Not
skills.title: Waste Not, Want Not
skills.desc: Spell. If target foe is not casting a spell or attacking, you gain 8..13 Energy.

skills.name: Sum of All Fears
skills.title: Sum of All Fears
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 4..12 second[s], target foe moves, attacks, and casts spells 33% slower.

skills.name: Withering Aura
skills.title: Withering Aura
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 5..20 seconds, target ally's melee attacks cause Weakness for 5..20 seconds.
notes: ANOMALY: Unlike Grenth's Aura, switching to a melee weapon before a weapon projectile hits does not trigger this skill.

skills.name: Cacophony
skills.title: Cacophony
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 15 seconds, whenever target foe uses a shout or chant, that foe takes 30..105 damage.

skills.name: Winter's Embrace
skills.title: Winter's Embrace
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 2..6 seconds, target foe moves 66% slower and takes 5..15 damage while moving.

skills.name: Earthen Shackles
skills.title: Earthen Shackles
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 3 seconds, target and all nearby foes move 90% slower. When Earthen Shackles ends, it applies Weakness for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Ward of Weakness
skills.title: Ward of Weakness
skills.desc: Ward Spell. You create a Ward of Weakness at your current location. For 5..20 seconds, foes in this area become Weakened for 5..20 seconds whenever they take elemental damage.
notes: BUG: Similar to Ward of Stability, this ward spell's recharge time cannot be decreased. E.g. activating this ward spell while under the effects of Glyph of Renewal or Glyph of Swiftness will consume the glyph, but the recharge time will not be decreased. However, the recharge time can be increased, e.g. by Glyph of Sacrifice.
ANOMALY: The weakness duration is independent of duration modifiers such as the Heavy weapon upgrade.

skills.name: Glyph of Swiftness
skills.title: Glyph of Swiftness
skills.desc: Glyph. For 15 seconds, your next 1..5 spell[s] recharge 25% faster and projectiles from the affected spells move 200% faster.
notes: BUG: Projectile speed boost only affects first projectile from Lava Arrows, Stone Daggers and Dancing Daggers when only one charge of Glyph of Swiftness remains.

skills.name: Cure Hex
skills.title: Cure Hex
skills.desc: Spell. Remove one Hex from target ally. If a Hex was removed, that ally is healed for 30..100 Health.

skills.name: Smite Condition
skills.title: Smite Condition
skills.desc: Spell. Remove one condition from target ally. If a condition was removed, foes in the area take 10..60 holy damage.
notes: BUG: The effect area is actually nearby foes.

skills.name: Castigation Signet
skills.title: Castigation Signet
skills.desc: Signet. Target foe takes 26..56 holy damage. If that foe was attacking, you gain 4..14 Energy.

skills.name: Purifying Veil
skills.title: Purifying Veil
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, conditions expire 5..50% faster on target ally. When this enchantment ends, one condition is removed from that ally.

skills.name: Pulverizing Smash
skills.title: Pulverizing Smash
skills.desc: Hammer Attack. If you hit a knocked-down foe, that foe suffers from Weakness and a Deep Wound for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Keen Chop
skills.title: Keen Chop
skills.desc: Axe Attack. If it hits, this attack always results in a critical hit.

skills.name: Knee Cutter
skills.title: Knee Cutter
skills.desc: Sword Attack. If this attack hits a Crippled foe, you gain 2..7 Energy and 1..3 strikes of adrenaline.

skills.name: Grapple
skills.title: Grapple
skills.desc: Skill. You and target touched foe are knocked down. You lose your current stance.
notes: ANOMALY: This skill has no aftercast delay, though this can only be observed if the self knockdown is prevented.

skills.name: Radiant Scythe
skills.title: Radiant Scythe
skills.desc: Scythe Attack. This attack strikes for +1 damage for each point of Energy you currently have, maximum 5..30. You gain 1..7 Energy if this attack hits.
notes: BUG: Despite the phrasing of the full description, the energy gain occurs even if the attack fails to hit (as correctly noted in the concise description).

skills.name: Grenth's Aura
skills.title: Grenth's Aura
skills.desc: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you deal 5..25 less damage and steal 5..25 Health whenever you hit with a scythe attack. When you cast this enchantment you steal 5..25 Health from all adjacent foes.
notes: BUG: If a ranged weapon is swapped for a scythe after the attack was made and before the projectile hit, Grenth's Aura will count this projectile hit as a scythe hit.

skills.name: Energetic Was Lee Sa
skills.title: Energetic Was Lee Sa
skills.desc: Item Spell. Hold Lee Sa's ashes for 5..15 seconds. While you hold her ashes, you gain +2 Energy regeneration. When you drop her ashes, you gain +1..10 Energy.

skills.name: Anthem of Weariness
skills.title: Anthem of Weariness
skills.desc: Chant. For 8 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot also causes Weakness for 1..16 second[s].

skills.name: Shadow Fang
skills.title: Shadow Fang
skills.desc: Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. For 10 seconds, this hex does nothing. When this hex ends, you return to your original location and that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Shrinking Armor
skills.title: Shrinking Armor
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe suffers from -1..4 Health degeneration. When this hex ends, that foe has Cracked Armor for 5..20 seconds.

skills.name: Aneurysm
skills.title: Aneurysm
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe regains all Energy. For each point of Energy gained in this way, that foe takes 1..3 damage and all adjacent foes lose 1 Energy. (Maximum 1..30).
notes: ANOMALY: Aneurysm does not take overcast into account when calculating how much energy to generate; as such, it combines well with skills that force overcast (such as Arcane Languor or Exhausting Assault) as it will deal high damage without actually returning energy.

skills.name: Foul Feast
skills.title: Foul Feast
skills.desc: Spell. All conditions are transferred from target other ally to yourself. For each condition acquired in this way, you gain 0..45 Health and 2..4 Energy. This skill recharges twice as fast if you remove Disease from your target.
notes: ANOMALY: This Soul Reaping skill uses the Blood Magic casting symbol because it was originally a Blood Magic skill.
BUG: If this skill transfers Disease, it will recharge in 2 seconds regardless of modifiers affecting its recharge such as Diversion.
BUG: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
BUG: Activating this skill while hexed with Soul Bind will damage the user even if no conditions are transferred.

skills.name: Putrid Bile
skills.title: Putrid Bile
skills.desc: Hex Spell. For 5..25 seconds, target foe suffers -1..3 Health degeneration. If that foe dies while under the effects of this hex, all nearby foes take 25..85 damage.

skills.name: Shell Shock
skills.title: Shell Shock
skills.desc: Spell. Target foe is struck for 10..30 lightning damage and has Cracked Armor for 5..20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes adjacent foes.

skills.name: Glyph of Immolation
skills.title: Glyph of Immolation
skills.desc: Glyph. For 15 seconds, your next 1..4 spell[s] that target[s] a foe also cause[s] Burning for 1..4 second[s].

skills.name: Patient Spirit
skills.title: Patient Spirit
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 2 seconds, target ally is enchanted with Patient Spirit. Unless this enchantment ends prematurely, that ally is healed for 30..120 Health when the enchantment ends.

skills.name: Healing Ribbon

skills.desc: Spell. Target other ally is healed for 20..110 Health. Up to 2 additional allies near target ally are healed for 10..100 Health.

skills.title: Aura of Stability
skills.desc: Enchantment Spell. For 3..8 seconds, target other ally cannot be knocked down.

skills.title: Spotless Mind
